        "contents": "# Codex Secure Configuration (TLS/mTLS + Encrypted Agents)\n# バージョン: v0.51.0-zapabob.1 (Secure Edition)\n# 作成日: 2025-10-28\n# 設計書: _docs/2025-10-28_セキュア通信アーキテクチャ設計書.md\n#\n# 📋 使用方法:\n#   1. zapabob/scripts/generate-mcp-certs.ps1 を実行して証明書生成\n#   2. config.toml をこのファイルで置き換えるか、設定をマージ\n#   3. codex --config config-secure.toml で起動\n\n# ==================== 基本設定 ====================\nmodel = \"gpt-5-codex\"\n\n# 🆕 MCP Client機能を有効化\nexperimental_use_rmcp_client = true\n\n# 🔍 Web検索機能を有効化（モデル組み込み検索）\nenable_web_search = true\n\n# ==================== 機能フラグ ====================\n[features]\n# Web検索機能（モデル組み込み）\nweb_search = true\n# MCP統合\nmcp_integration = true\n# 🔐 セキュアモード（TLS/mTLS + 暗号化）\nsecure_mode = true\n\n# ==================== OpenAI Provider ====================\n[model_providers.openai]\nbase_url = \"https://api.openai.com/v1\"\nenv_key = \"OPENAI_API_KEY\"\nname = \"OpenAI (Chat Completions API)\"\nrequires_openai_auth = true\nwire_api = \"chat\"\nenable_web_search = true\nweb_search_grounding = true\n\n# ==================== セキュリティ ====================\n[security]\n# ゼロトラストモード\nzero_trust_mode = true\n\n# TLS/mTLS設定\ntls_enabled = true\ntls_version = \"1.3\"  # TLS 1.3のみ許可（TLS 1.2以下は拒否）\nmtls_enabled = true  # 相互TLS認証（クライアント証明書必須）\n\n[security.certificates]\n# 証明書パス（~/.codex/certs/）\nca_cert = \"~/.codex/certs/ca/ca-cert.pem\"\nclient_cert = \"~/.codex/certs/codex/codex-cert.pem\"\nclient_key = \"~/.codex/certs/codex/codex-key.pem\"\nverify_peer = true  # ピア証明書の検証を強制\n\n# 証明書ローテーション\n[security.certificates.rotation]\nenabled = true\nrotation_days = 90  # 90日ごとに自動ローテーション\nwarn_before_expiry_days = 14  # 14日前に警告\n\n[security.signing]",

        "contents": "    tls_config: Arc&lt;ClientConfig&gt;,\n}\n\nimpl SecureMcpConnectionManager {\n    /// Create a new secure connection manager\n    pub fn new(config: &amp;SecureMcpConfig) -&gt; Result&lt;Self&gt; {\n        let tls_config = Self::build_tls_config(config)?;\n\n        Ok(Self {\n            tls_config: Arc::new(tls_config),\n        })\n    }\n\n    /// Build TLS 1.3 configuration\n    fn build_tls_config(config: &amp;SecureMcpConfig) -&gt; Result&lt;ClientConfig&gt; {\n        // Load CA certificates (root of trust)\n        let ca_certs = Self::load_ca_certificates(&amp;config.ca_cert_path)?;\n\n        let mut root_store = RootCertStore::empty();\n        for cert in ca_certs {\n            root_store\n                .add(cert)\n                .context(\"Failed to add CA cert to root store\")?;\n        }\n\n        // Build TLS config based on whether mTLS is enabled\n        let tls_config = if let (Some(client_cert_path), Some(client_key_path)) =\n            (&amp;config.client_cert_path, &amp;config.client_key_path)\n        {\n            // mTLS: Load client certificate and key\n            let client_certs = Self::load_certificates(client_cert_path)?;\n            let client_key = Self::load_private_key(client_key_path)?;\n\n            ClientConfig::builder()\n                .with_root_certificates(root_store)\n                .with_client_auth_cert(client_certs, client_key)\n                .context(\"Failed to configure TLS with client auth\")?\n        } else {\n            // TLS only (no client certificate)\n            ClientConfig::builder()\n                .with_root_certificates(root_store)\n                .with_no_client_auth()\n        };\n\n        Ok(tls_config)\n    }\n\n    /// Load CA certificates from PEM file\n    fn load_ca_certificates(path: &amp;str) -&gt; Result&lt;Vec&lt;rustls::pki_types::CertificateDer&lt;'static&gt;&gt;&gt; {\n        let path = Self::expand_path(path);\n        let file = File::open(&amp;path)\n            .with_context",

        "contents": "env.OPENAI_API_KEY = \"${OPENAI_API_KEY}\"\nenv.GITHUB_TOKEN = \"${GITHUB_TOKEN}\"\nenv.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL = \"${SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL}\"\nstartup_timeout_sec = 60\n\n# 🔒 TLS/mTLS設定\ntransport = \"https\"  # 🆕 HTTPSに変更（stdio→TCP+TLS）\nbind_address = \"127.0.0.1:8001\"\ntls_cert = \"~/.codex/certs/mcp-servers/codex-cert.pem\"\ntls_key = \"~/.codex/certs/mcp-servers/codex-key.pem\"\nrequire_client_cert = true  # mTLS必須\n\n# 🔐 認証設定\nauth_method = \"mtls\"  # mTLS認証\ntrusted_ca = \"~/.codex/certs/ca/ca-cert.pem\"\n\n# Serena -       "codeBlock": {

        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 62
          }
        },
        "contents": "# Codex Secure Configuration (TLS/mTLS + Encrypted Agents)\n# バージョン: v0.51.0-zapabob.1 (Secure Edition)\n# 作成日: 2025-10-28\n# 設計書: _docs/2025-10-28_セキュア通信アーキテクチャ設計書.md\n#\n# 📋 使用方法:\n#   1. zapabob/scripts/generate-mcp-certs.ps1 を実行して証明書生成\n#   2. config.toml をこのファイルで置き換えるか、設定をマージ\n#   3. codex --config config-secure.toml で起動\n\n# ==================== 基本設定 ====================\nmodel = \"gpt-5-codex\"\n\n# 🆕 MCP Client機能を有効化\nexperimental_use_rmcp_client = true\n\n# 🔍 Web検索機能を有効化（モデル組み込み検索）\nenable_web_search = true\n\n# ==================== 機能フラグ ====================\n[features]\n# Web検索機能（モデル組み込み）\nweb_search = true\n# MCP統合\nmcp_integration = true\n# 🔐 セキュアモード（TLS/mTLS + 暗号化）\nsecure_mode = true\n\n# ==================== OpenAI Provider ====================\n[model_providers.openai]\nbase_url = \"https://api.openai.com/v1\"\nenv_key = \"OPENAI_API_KEY\"\nname = \"OpenAI (Chat Completions API)\"\nrequires_openai_auth = true\nwire_api = \"chat\"\nenable_web_search = true\nweb_search_grounding = true\n\n# ==================== セキュリティ ====================\n[security]\n# ゼロトラストモード\nzero_trust_mode = true\n\n# TLS/mTLS設定\ntls_enabled = true\ntls_version = \"1.3\"  # TLS 1.3のみ許可（TLS 1.2以下は拒否）\nmtls_enabled = true  # 相互TLS認証（クライアント証明書必須）\n\n[security.certificates]\n# 証明書パス（~/.codex/certs/）\nca_cert = \"~/.codex/certs/ca/ca-cert.pem\"\nclient_cert = \"~/.codex/certs/codex/codex-cert.pem\"\nclient_key = \"~/.codex/certs/codex/codex-key.pem\"\nverify_peer = true  # ピア証明書の検証を強制\n\n# 証明書ローテーション\n[security.certificates.rotation]\nenabled = true\nrotation_days = 90  # 90日ごとに自動ローテーション\nwarn_before_expiry_days = 14  # 14日前に警告\n\n[security.signing]",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "# Chrome DevTools - ブラウザ自動化（TLS/mTLS）\n[mcp_servers.chrome-devtools]\ncommand = \"npx\"\nargs = [\"-y\", \"@modelcontextprotocol/server-chrome\"]\ntransport = \"https\"\nbind_address = \"127.0.0.1:8006\"\ntls_cert = \"~/.codex/certs/mcp-servers/chrome-devtools-cert.pem\"\ntls_key = \"~/.codex/certs/mcp-servers/chrome-devtools-key.pem\"\nrequire_client_cert = true\nauth_method = \"mtls\"\n\n# Sequential Thinking - 段階的思考（TLS/mTLS）\n[mcp_servers.sequential-thinking]\ncommand = \"npx\"\nargs = [\"-y\", \"@modelcontextprotocol/server-sequential-thinking\"]\ntransport = \"https\"\nbind_address = \"127.0.0.1:8007\"\ntls_cert = \"~/.codex/certs/mcp-servers/sequential-thinking-cert.pem\"\ntls_key = \"~/.codex/certs/mcp-servers/sequential-thinking-key.pem\"\nrequire_client_cert = true\nauth_method = \"mtls\"\n\n# ... (他のMCPサーバーも同様にTLS/mTLS設定)\n\n# ==================== サブエージェント ====================\n[subagents]\nenabled = true\nmax_parallel = 4\ntoken_budget = 40000\ninherit_model = true\nuse_codex_mcp = true\n\n# 🔐 セキュア通信有効化\nsecure_channel = true\nencryption_enabled = true\nsigning_enabled = true\n\n# ==================== Deep Research ====================\n[deep_research]\nenabled = true\ndefault_backend = \"gemini\"  # Gemini Search Grounding\nfallback_backends = [\"duckduckgo\", \"google\", \"bing\"]\nmax_sources = 10\ncitation_style = \"academic\"\n\n# ==================== セキュリティモニタリング ====================\n[monitoring]\nenabled = true\nprometheus_endpoint = \"http://localhost:9090\"\ngrafana_dashboard_url = \"http://localhost:3000/d/codex-security\"\n\n[monitoring.metrics]\n# 収集するメトリクス\ncollect_tls_metrics = true\ncollect_auth_metrics = true\ncollect_rate_limit_metrics = true\ncollect_agent_metrics = true\n\n[monitoring.export]\n# メトリクスのエクスポート\nformat = \"prometheus\"\nexport_interval_sec = 30\n\n# ==================== バックアップ ====================\n[backup]\nenabled = true\nbackup_dir = \"~/.codex/backups\"\nbackup_interval_hours = 24\nretention_days = 30\n\n# バックアップ対象",

        "contents": "//! Sandboxed Execution System (Rust 2024)\n//!\n//! Provides secure command execution with AI-powered destructive command detection\n//! and prevention, featuring internet connectivity controls and macOS-style UX.\n\nuse serde::Deserialize;\nuse serde::Serialize;\nuse std::collections::HashMap;\nuse std::collections::HashSet;\nuse std::sync::Arc;\nuse tokio::sync::RwLock;\nuse tokio::sync::mpsc;\nuse tokio::time::Duration;\n\n/// Sandbox execution mode\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub enum SandboxMode {\n    /// Full isolation - no network, limited filesystem\n    Isolated,\n    /// Network access allowed but monitored\n    NetworkIsolated,\n    /// Full access with AI monitoring\n    Supervised,\n    /// macOS-style sandbox with internet access\n    MacOSSandbox,\n}\n\n/// AI security analysis result\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct AISecurityAnalysis {\n    pub command_id: String,\n    pub risk_level: SecurityRiskLevel,\n    pub risk_score: f64,\n    pub detected_threats: Vec&lt;SecurityThreat&gt;,\n    pub mitigation_suggestions: Vec&lt;String&gt;,\n    pub allow_execution: bool,\n    pub requires_approval: bool,\n    pub analysis_timestamp: chrono::DateTime&lt;chrono::Utc&gt;,\n}\n\n/// Security risk levels\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, PartialOrd, Ord, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub enum SecurityRiskLevel {\n    Safe,\n    Low,\n    Medium,\n    High,\n    Critical,\n}\n\n/// Detected security threats\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct SecurityThreat {\n    pub threat_type: ThreatType,\n    pub description: String,\n    pub severity: SecurityRiskLevel,\n    pub location: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n    pub confidence: f64,\n}\n\n/// Types of security threats\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub enum ThreatType {\n    DestructiveFileOperation,\n    NetworkAttack,\n    PrivilegeEscalation,\n    DataExfiltration,\n    MalwareExecution,\n    UnauthorizedAccess,\n    ResourceExhaustion,\n}\n\n/// Sandbox execution request",

        "contents": "    async fn start_sandboxed_execution(\n        &amp;self,\n        request: SandboxExecutionRequest,\n        security_analysis: Option&lt;AISecurityAnalysis&gt;,\n    ) {\n        let result_sender = self.result_sender.clone();\n        let config = self.config.clone();\n\n        tokio::spawn(async move {\n            let start_time = tokio::time::Instant::now();\n\n            // Execute based on sandbox mode\n            let result = match request.sandbox_mode {\n                SandboxMode::Isolated =&gt; Self::execute_isolated(request, &amp;config).await,\n                SandboxMode::NetworkIsolated =&gt; {\n                    Self::execute_network_isolated(request, &amp;config).await\n                }\n                SandboxMode::Supervised =&gt; Self::execute_supervised(request, &amp;config).await,\n                SandboxMode::MacOSSandbox =&gt; Self::execute_macos_sandbox(request, &amp;config).await,\n            };\n\n            let execution_time = start_time.elapsed().as_millis() as u64;\n\n            // Create final result\n            let execution_result = SandboxExecutionResult {\n                request_id: result.request_id,\n                success: result.success,\n                exit_code: result.exit_code,\n                stdout: result.stdout,\n                stderr: result.stderr,\n                execution_time_ms: execution_time,\n                resources_used: result.resources_used,\n                network_activity: result.network_activity,\n                security_events: result.security_events,\n                ai_analysis: security_analysis,\n                sandbox_mode_used: request.sandbox_mode,\n                completed_at: chrono::Utc::now(),\n            };\n\n            // Send result\n            let _ = result_sender.send(execution_result);\n        });\n    }\n\n    /// Execute in isolated sandbox (no network, limited filesystem)\n    async fn execute_isolated(\n        request: SandboxExecutionRequest,\n        _config: &amp;SandboxConfig,\n    ) -&gt;         "contents": "/// Permission Checker for Agent Tool Execution\n///\n/// Validates tool calls against agent-specific permissions before execution.\nuse anyhow::Result;\n/// Permission Checker for Agent Tool Execution\n///\n/// Validates tool calls against agent-specific permissions before execution.\nuse anyhow::anyhow;\nuse once_cell::sync::Lazy;\nuse regex::Regex;\nuse std::collections::HashMap;\nuse std::path::Path;\nuse std::path::PathBuf;\nuse std::sync::Mutex;\n\nuse super::types::FsWritePermission;\nuse super::types::ShellPermissions;\nuse super::types::ToolPermissions;\n\n/// Permission checker for agent tool execution\npub struct PermissionChecker {\n    /// Tool permissions for this agent\n    permissions: ToolPermissions,\n}\n\nimpl PermissionChecker {\n    /// Create a new permission checker\n    pub fn new(permissions: ToolPermissions) -&gt; Self {\n        Self { permissions }\n    }\n\n    /// Check if an MCP tool is allowed\n    pub fn check_mcp_tool(&amp;self, tool_name: &amp;str) -&gt; Result&lt;()&gt; {\n        if self.permissions.mcp.contains(&amp;tool_name.to_string()) {\n            Ok(())\n        } else if self.permissions.mcp.contains(&amp;\"*\".to_string()) {\n            // Wildcard allows all tools\n            Ok(())\n        } else {\n            Err(anyhow!(\n                \"MCP tool '{}' is not permitted. Allowed tools: {:?}\",\n                tool_name,\n                self.permissions.mcp\n            ))\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Check if file read is allowed\n    pub fn check_file_read(&amp;self, _path: &amp;Path) -&gt; Result&lt;()&gt; {\n        if self.permissions.fs.read {\n            Ok(())\n        } else {\n            Err(anyhow!(\"File read permission denied\"))\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Check if file write is allowed\n    pub fn check_file_write(&amp;self, path: &amp;Path) -&gt; Result&lt;()&gt; {\n        match &amp;self.permissions.fs.write {\n            FsWritePermission::Flag(true) =&gt; Ok(()),",

        "contents": "        let mut artifacts = Vec::new();\n\n        for iteration in 0..max_iterations {\n            debug!(\"Agent iteration {}/{}\", iteration + 1, max_iterations);\n\n            // LLM呼び出し\n            let llm_response = self\n                .call_llm_for_agent(&amp;conversation_history)\n                .await\n                .context(\"Failed to call LLM for agent\")?;\n\n            conversation_history.push((\"assistant\".to_string(), llm_response.clone()));\n            artifacts.push(llm_response.clone());\n\n            // ツールコール検出\n            let tool_calls = self.detect_tool_calls(&amp;llm_response);\n\n            if tool_calls.is_empty() {\n                // ツールコールがない場合は終了\n                info!(\"No more tool calls detected. Agent task completed.\");\n                break;\n            }\n\n            // ツール実行\n            let mut tool_results = Vec::new();\n            for (tool_name, tool_args) in tool_calls {\n                if !allowed_tools.contains(&amp;tool_name) {\n                    let error_msg =\n                        format!(\"ERROR: Tool '{tool_name}' is not permitted for this agent\");\n                    tool_results.push(error_msg);\n                    continue;\n                }\n\n                info!(\n                    \"Executing Codex MCP tool: {} with args: {:?}\",\n                    tool_name, tool_args\n                );\n\n                match self\n                    .execute_codex_mcp_tool(&amp;mcp_client, &amp;tool_name, tool_args)\n                    .await\n                {\n                    Ok(result) =&gt; {\n                        tool_results.push(format!(\"TOOL_RESULT[{tool_name}]: {result}\"));\n                    }\n                    Err(e) =&gt; {\n                        let error_msg = format!(\"ERROR executing tool '{tool_name}': {e}\");\n                        error!(\"{error_msg}\");\n                        tool_results.push(error_msg);\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n\n            // ツール結果をLLMにフィードバック\n            let feedback = tool_results.join(\"\\n\\n\");\n            conversation_history.push((\"user\".to_string(), feedback.clone()));",

        "contents": "    pub async fn delegate(\n        &amp;self,\n        agent_name: &amp;str,\n        goal: &amp;str,\n        inputs: HashMap&lt;String, String&gt;,\n        budget: Option&lt;usize&gt;,\n        deadline: Option&lt;u64&gt;,\n    ) -&gt; Result&lt;AgentResult&gt; {\n        info!(\"Delegating to agent '{}': {}\", agent_name, goal);\n\n        // エージェント定義を読み込み\n        let agent_def = {\n            let mut loader = self.loader.write().await;\n            loader\n                .load_by_name(agent_name)\n                .with_context(|| format!(\"Failed to load agent '{agent_name}'\"))?\n        };\n\n        // 共有情報を入力へ取り込む\n        let mut inputs = inputs;\n        let shared_context_snapshot = self.collaboration_store.get_all_context();\n        if !shared_context_snapshot.is_empty()\n            &amp;&amp; let Ok(serialized) = serde_json::to_string(&amp;shared_context_snapshot)\n        {\n            inputs.insert(\"shared_context\".to_string(), serialized);\n        }\n\n        let prior_results_snapshot = self.collaboration_store.get_all_results();\n        if !prior_results_snapshot.is_empty()\n            &amp;&amp; let Ok(serialized) = serde_json::to_string(&amp;prior_results_snapshot)\n        {\n            inputs.insert(\"collaboration_results\".to_string(), serialized);\n        }\n\n        // 予算を設定\n        if let Some(budget) = budget {\n            self.budgeter.set_agent_limit(agent_name, budget)?;\n        } else {\n            // デフォルト予算はコンテキストポリシーから取得\n            self.budgeter\n                .set_agent_limit(agent_name, agent_def.policies.context.max_tokens)?;\n        }\n\n        // 実行ステータスを更新\n        {\n            let mut running = self.running_agents.write().await;\n            running.insert(agent_name.to_string(), AgentStatus::Running);\n        }\n\n        // 実行開始\n        let start_time = Instant::now();\n        let start_timestamp = chrono::Utc::now().to_rfc3339();\n\n        // 監査ログ: エージェント開始\n        let _ = log_audit_event(AuditEvent::new(\n            agent_name.to_string(),\n            AuditEventType::AgentExecution",

        "contents": "    pub async fn validate_plan(\n        &amp;self,\n        plan: &amp;ImprovementPlan,\n    ) -&gt; Result&lt;PlanValidationResult, String&gt; {\n        let mut validation_results = Vec::new();\n        let mut total_risk_score = 0.0;\n\n        for action in &amp;plan.actions {\n            // Validate each action\n            let validation = self.validate_single_action(action).await?;\n            validation_results.push(validation.clone());\n\n            // Accumulate risk\n            total_risk_score += match validation.risk_level {\n                RiskLevel::VeryLow =&gt; 0.1,\n                RiskLevel::Low =&gt; 0.2,\n                RiskLevel::Medium =&gt; 0.4,\n                RiskLevel::High =&gt; 0.7,\n                RiskLevel::VeryHigh =&gt; 1.0,\n            };\n        }\n\n        let overall_risk = if total_risk_score &gt;= 2.0 {\n            RiskLevel::VeryHigh\n        } else if total_risk_score &gt;= 1.5 {\n            RiskLevel::High\n        } else if total_risk_score &gt;= 1.0 {\n            RiskLevel::Medium\n        } else if total_risk_score &gt;= 0.5 {\n            RiskLevel::Low\n        } else {\n            RiskLevel::VeryLow\n        };\n\n        Ok(PlanValidationResult {\n            is_valid: validation_results.iter().all(|v| v.is_valid),\n            overall_risk_level: overall_risk,\n            action_validations: validation_results,\n            recommended_strategy: self.recommend_execution_strategy(plan, overall_risk),\n        })\n    }\n\n    // Implementation methods\n    async fn load_file(&amp;self, file_path: &amp;str) -&gt; Result&lt;String, String&gt; {\n        tokio::fs::read_to_string(file_path)\n            .await\n            .map_err(|e| format!(\"Failed to load file {}: {}\", file_path, e))\n    }\n\n    async fn prioritize_improvements(\n        &amp;self,",

        "contents": "    async fn generate_security_recommendations(\n        &amp;self,\n        analysis: &amp;AISecurityAnalysis,\n    ) -&gt; Vec&lt;String&gt; {\n        let mut recommendations = analysis.mitigation_suggestions.clone();\n\n        // Add general recommendations based on risk level\n        match analysis.risk_level {\n            SecurityRiskLevel::Critical =&gt; {\n                recommendations.push(\n                    \"🚫 CRITICAL: This command is blocked due to high security risk\".to_string(),\n                );\n                recommendations.push(\n                    \"Consider alternative approaches that don't involve destructive operations\"\n                        .to_string(),\n                );\n                recommendations.push(\"Consult with security team before proceeding\".to_string());\n            }\n            SecurityRiskLevel::High =&gt; {\n                recommendations\n                    .push(\"⚠️ HIGH RISK: Manual review required before execution\".to_string());\n                recommendations.push(\"Execute in isolated environment first\".to_string());\n                recommendations.push(\"Ensure backups are available\".to_string());\n            }\n            SecurityRiskLevel::Medium =&gt; {\n                recommendations.push(\"⚡ MEDIUM RISK: Execute with caution\".to_string());\n                recommendations.push(\"Monitor execution closely\".to_string());\n                recommendations.push(\"Have rollback plan ready\".to_string());\n            }\n            SecurityRiskLevel::Low =&gt; {\n                recommendations.push(\"✅ LOW RISK: Generally safe to execute\".to_string());\n                recommendations.push(\"Standard monitoring recommended\".to_string());\n            }\n            SecurityRiskLevel::Safe =&gt; {\n                recommendations.push(\"✅ SAFE: No security concerns detected\".to_string());\n            }\n        }\n\n        recommendations\n    }\n}\n\nimpl AISandboxExecutor {\n    /// Create new AI-powered sandbox executor",

        "contents": "}\n\npub fn command_might_be_dangerous(command: &amp;[String]) -&gt; bool {\n    #[cfg(windows)]\n    {\n        if windows_dangerous_commands::is_dangerous_command_windows(command) {\n            return true;\n        }\n    }\n\n    if is_dangerous_to_call_with_exec(command) {\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    // Support &#96;bash -lc \"&lt;script&gt;\"&#96; where the any part of the script might contain a dangerous command.\n    if let Some(all_commands) = parse_shell_lc_plain_commands(command)\n        &amp;&amp; all_commands\n            .iter()\n            .any(|cmd| is_dangerous_to_call_with_exec(cmd))\n    {\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    false\n}\n\nfn is_dangerous_to_call_with_exec(command: &amp;[String]) -&gt; bool {\n    let cmd0 = command.first().map(String::as_str);\n\n    match cmd0 {\n        Some(cmd) if cmd.ends_with(\"git\") || cmd.ends_with(\"/git\") =&gt; {\n            matches!(command.get(1).map(String::as_str), Some(\"reset\" | \"rm\"))\n        }\n\n        Some(\"rm\") =&gt; matches!(command.get(1).map(String::as_str), Some(\"-f\" | \"-rf\")),\n\n        // for sudo &lt;cmd&gt; simply do the check for &lt;cmd&gt;\n        Some(\"sudo\") =&gt; is_dangerous_to_call_with_exec(&amp;command[1..]),\n\n        // ── anything else ─────────────────────────────────────────────────\n        _ =&gt; false,\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n    use codex_protocol::protocol::NetworkAccess;",

This is a\n    // best-effort shlex split of the script text, not a full PS parser.\n    let Some(parsed) = parse_powershell_invocation(rest) else {\n        return false;\n    };\n\n    let tokens_lc: Vec&lt;String&gt; = parsed\n        .tokens\n        .iter()\n        .map(|t| t.trim_matches('\\'').trim_matches('\"').to_ascii_lowercase())\n        .collect();\n    let has_url = args_have_url(&amp;parsed.tokens);\n\n    if has_url\n        &amp;&amp; tokens_lc.iter().any(|t| {\n            matches!(\n                t.as_str(),\n                \"start-process\" | \"start\" | \"saps\" | \"invoke-item\" | \"ii\"\n            ) || t.contains(\"start-process\")\n                || t.contains(\"invoke-item\")\n        })\n    {\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    if has_url\n        &amp;&amp; tokens_lc\n            .iter()\n            .any(|t| t.contains(\"shellexecute\") || t.contains(\"shell.application\"))\n    {\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    if let Some(first) = tokens_lc.first()",

        "contents": "    {\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    if let Some(first) = tokens_lc.first() {\n        // Legacy ShellExecute path via url.dll\n        if first == \"rundll32\"\n            &amp;&amp; tokens_lc\n                .iter()\n                .any(|t| t.contains(\"url.dll,fileprotocolhandler\"))\n            &amp;&amp; has_url\n        {\n            return true;\n        }\n        if first == \"mshta\" &amp;&amp; has_url {\n            return true;\n        }\n        if is_browser_executable(first) &amp;&amp; has_url {\n            return true;\n        }\n        if matches!(first.as_str(), \"explorer\" | \"explorer.exe\") &amp;&amp; has_url {\n            return true;\n        }\n    }\n\n    false\n}\n\nfn is_dangerous_cmd(command: &amp;[String]) -&gt; bool {\n    let Some((exe, rest)) = command.split_first() else {\n        return false;\n    };\n    let Some(base) = executable_basename(exe) else {\n        return false;\n    };\n    if base != \"cmd\" &amp;&amp; base != \"cmd.exe\" {\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    let mut iter = rest.iter();\n    for arg in iter.by_ref() {\n        let lower = arg.to_ascii_lowercase();\n        match lower.as_str() {\n            \"/c\" | \"/r\" | \"-c\" =&gt; break,\n            _ if lower.starts_with('/') =&gt; continue,\n            // Unknown tokens before the command body =&gt; bail.\n            _ =&gt; return false,\n        }\n    }\n\n    let Some(first_cmd) = iter.next() else {\n        return false;\n    };\n    // Classic &#96;cmd /c start https://...&#96; ShellExecute path.\n    if !first_cmd.eq_ignore_ascii_case(\"start\") {\n        return false;\n    }\n    let remaining: Vec&lt;String&gt; = iter.cloned().collect();\n    args_have_url(&amp;remaining)\n}\n\nfn is_direct_gui_launch(command: &amp;[String]) -&gt;",

Dangerous commands cannot be executed even in YOLO mode for security reasons.\",\n            command_str\n        ),\n        data: Some(serde_json::json!({\n            \"blocked\": true,\n            \"reason\": \"dangerous_command\",\n            \"command\": command_str\n        })),\n    });\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Phase 5.5: 仮想OSターミナルでのブロック実装\n\n**ファイル**: &#96;codex-rs/core/src/virtualization/terminal.rs&#96;\n\n**変更内容**:\n- &#96;execute_command&#96;メソッドで、危険なコマンドをチェックしてブロック\n- エラーメッセージを更新して、YOLOモードでもブロックされることを明記\n\n**実装詳細**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;rust\n// YOLOモードでも危険なコマンドは完全にブロック\nif command_might_be_dangerous(&amp;command) {\n    warn!(\"Dangerous command blocked (even in YOLO mode): {:?}\", command);\n    let result = TerminalResult {\n        exit_code: 1,\n        stdout: String::new(),\n        stderr: format!(\n            \"Error: Dangerous command blocked for security reasons (even in YOLO mode): {:?}.         "contents": "# 仮想OSターミナル実装完了\n\n**日時**: 2025-11-25 03:55:19  \n**タスク**: 仮想OSからターミナル経由で各種インストール済みCLIを呼び出し、危険なシェルコマンドをブロック\n\n---\n\n## 概要\n\n仮想OS環境内でターミナル経由で各種インストール済みCLIを呼び出せる機能を実装しました。既存のコマンド安全性チェック機能を統合し、危険なシェルコマンドを明示的にブロックします。\n\n## 実装内容\n\n### 1. &#96;terminal.rs&#96;の実装\n\n**ファイル**: &#96;codex-rs/core/src/virtualization/terminal.rs&#96; (新規作成)\n\n**実装内容**:\n- 仮想OS環境内でのターミナルセッション管理\n- CLIコマンド実行機能\n- 危険なコマンドの検出とブロック\n- インストール済みCLIの検出機能\n- コマンド履歴管理\n- ネットワークアクセス制御との統合\n\n**主な機能**:\n- &#96;TerminalSession&#96;: ターミナルセッションの管理\n- &#96;TerminalManager&#96;: 複数セッションの管理\n- &#96;execute_command()&#96;: コマンド実行（安全性チェック付き）\n- &#96;list_available_commands()&#96;: インストール済みCLIの一覧取得\n- &#96;get_history()&#96;: コマンド履歴の取得\n- &#96;change_directory()&#96;: 作業ディレクトリの変更\n\n**安全性チェック**:\n- &#96;command_might_be_dangerous()&#96;: 危険なコマンドの検出\n- &#96;is_known_safe_command()&#96;: 安全なコマンドの確認\n- ネットワークアクセス制御との統合\n\n**ブロックされる危険なコマンド例**:\n- &#96;git reset&#96; / &#96;git rm&#96;: Git履歴の破壊\n- &#96;rm -rf /&#96;: システムファイルの削除\n- &#96;rm -f&#96;: 強制削除\n- &#96;sudo&#96;: 権限昇格\n- PowerShell/CMD経由のURL起動\n- ブラウザ経由のURL起動\n\n**許可される安全なコマンド例**:\n- &#96;git status&#96; / &#96;git log&#96; / &#96;git diff&#96;: Git情報取得\n- &#96;ls&#96; / &#96;cd&#96; / &#96;pwd&#96;: ファイルシステム操作（読み取り）\n- &#96;cat&#96; / &#96;grep&#96; / &#96;head&#96; / &#96;tail&#96;: ファイル読み取り\n- &#96;cargo check&#96;: Rustプロジェクトのチェック\n- &#96;node&#96; / &#96;python&#96; / &#96;go&#96;: 言語ランタイムの実行\n\n### 2. CLI統合",

};\n\n    let additional_dirs = cli.add_dir.clone();\n\n    let overrides = ConfigOverrides {\n        model,\n        approval_policy,\n        sandbox_mode,\n        cwd,\n        model_provider:         "contents": "    pub fn run_windows_sandbox_capture(\n        policy_json_or_preset: &amp;str,\n        sandbox_policy_cwd: &amp;Path,\n        codex_home: &amp;Path,\n        command: Vec&lt;String&gt;,\n        cwd: &amp;Path,\n        mut env_map: HashMap&lt;String, String&gt;,\n        timeout_ms: Option&lt;u64&gt;,\n    ) -&gt; Result&lt;CaptureResult&gt; {\n        let policy = parse_policy(policy_json_or_preset)?;\n        let apply_network_block = should_apply_network_block(&amp;policy);\n        normalize_null_device_env(&amp;mut env_map);\n        ensure_non_interactive_pager(&amp;mut env_map);\n        if apply_network_block {\n            apply_no_network_to_env(&amp;mut env_map)?;\n        }\n        ensure_codex_home_exists(codex_home)?;\n        let current_dir = cwd.to_path_buf();\n        let sandbox_base = codex_home.join(\".sandbox\");\n        std::fs::create_dir_all(&amp;sandbox_base)?;\n        let logs_base_dir = Some(sandbox_base.as_path());\n        log_start(&amp;command, logs_base_dir);\n        let is_workspace_write = matches!(&amp;policy, SandboxPolicy::WorkspaceWrite { .. });\n\n        if matches!(\n            &amp;policy,\n            SandboxPolicy::DangerFullAccess | SandboxPolicy::ExternalSandbox { .. }\n        ) {\n            anyhow::bail!(\"DangerFullAccess and ExternalSandbox are not supported for sandboxing\")\n        }\n        let caps = load_or_create_cap_sids(codex_home)?;\n        let (h_token, psid_to_use): (HANDLE, *mut c_void) = unsafe {\n            match &amp;policy {\n                SandboxPolicy::ReadOnly =&gt;",

        "contents": "impl WritableRoot {\n    pub fn is_path_writable(&amp;self, path: &amp;Path) -&gt; bool {\n        // Check if the path is under the root.\n        if !path.starts_with(&amp;self.root) {\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        // Check if the path is under any of the read-only subpaths.\n        for subpath in &amp;self.read_only_subpaths {\n            if path.starts_with(subpath) {\n                return false;\n            }\n        }\n\n        true\n    }\n}\n\nimpl FromStr for SandboxPolicy {\n    type Err = serde_json::Error;\n\n    fn from_str(s: &amp;str) -&gt; Result&lt;Self, Self::Err&gt; {\n        serde_json::from_str(s)\n    }\n}\n\nimpl SandboxPolicy {\n    /// Returns a policy with read-only disk access and no network.\n    pub fn new_read_only_policy() -&gt; Self {\n        SandboxPolicy::ReadOnly\n    }\n\n    /// Returns a policy that can read the entire disk, but can only write to\n    /// the current working directory and the per-user tmp dir on macOS. It does\n    /// not allow network access.\n    pub fn new_workspace_write_policy() -&gt; Self {\n        SandboxPolicy::WorkspaceWrite {\n            writable_roots: vec![],\n            network_access: false,\n            exclude_tmpdir_env_var: false,\n            exclude_slash_tmp: false,\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Always returns &#96;true&#96;; restricting read access is not supported.\n    pub fn has_full_disk_read_access(&amp;self) -&gt; bool {\n        true\n    }\n\n    pub fn has_full_disk_write_access(&amp;self) -&gt; bool {\n        match self {\n            SandboxPolicy::DangerFullAccess =&gt; true,\n            SandboxPolicy::ExternalSandbox { .. } =&gt; true,\n            SandboxPolicy::ReadOnly =&gt; false,\n            SandboxPolicy::WorkspaceWrite { .. } =&gt; false,\n        }\n    }\n\n    pub fn has_full_network_access(&amp;self) -&gt; bool",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "impl WritableRoot {",
            "lineNumber": 368
          },
          {
            "text": "    pub fn is_path_writable(&amp;self, path: &amp;Path) -&gt; bool {",

{\n                if let Some(path) = parameters.get(\"path\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {\n                    self.check_file_read(Path::new(path))?;\n                }\n                if let Some(path) = parameters.get(\"target_file\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {\n                    self.check_file_read(Path::new(path))?;\n                }\n            }\n            \"write\" | \"search_replace\" | \"delete_file\" =&gt; {\n                if let Some(path) = parameters.get(\"file_path\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {\n                    self.check_file_write(Path::new(path))?;\n                }\n                if let Some(path) = parameters.get(\"target_file\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {\n                    self.check_file_write(Path::new(path))?;\n                }\n            }\n            \"web_search\" | \"fetch\" | \"http_request\" =&gt; {\n                if let Some(url) = parameters.get(\"url\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {\n                    self.check_network_access(url)?;\n                }\n                if let Some(_url) = parameters.get(\"search_term\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {\n                    // For web_search, check if https://* is allowed\n                    self.check_network_access(\"https://search.brave.com\")?;\n                }\n            }\n            \"run_terminal_cmd\" | \"shell\" | \"exec\" =&gt; {\n                if let Some(cmd) = parameters.get(\"command\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {\n                    self.check_shell_command(cmd)?;\n                }\n            }\n            _ =&gt; {\n                // Unknown tool - rely on MCP permission check above\n            }\n        }\n\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// Get permission summary for logging\n    pub fn get_permission_summary(&amp;self) -&gt;         "contents": "use std::fs::OpenOptions;\nuse std::io::Read;\nuse std::io::Seek;\nuse std::io::SeekFrom;\nuse std::io::Write;\nuse std::path::Path;\nuse std::path::PathBuf;\n\nuse serde_json;\nuse thiserror::Error;\n\n#[derive(Debug, Error)]\npub enum AmendError {\n    #[error(\"prefix rule requires at least one token\")]\n    EmptyPrefix,\n    #[error(\"policy path has no parent: {path}\")]\n    MissingParent { path: PathBuf },\n    #[error(\"failed to create policy directory {dir}: {source}\")]\n    CreatePolicyDir {\n        dir: PathBuf,\n        source: std::io::Error,\n    },\n    #[error(\"failed to format prefix tokens: {source}\")]\n    SerializePrefix { source: serde_json::Error },\n    #[error(\"failed to open policy file {path}: {source}\")]\n    OpenPolicyFile {\n        path: PathBuf,\n        source: std::io::Error,\n    },\n    #[error(\"failed to write to policy file {path}: {source}\")]\n    WritePolicyFile {\n        path: PathBuf,\n        source: std::io::Error,\n    },\n    #[error(\"failed to lock policy file {path}: {source}\")]\n    LockPolicyFile {\n        path: PathBuf,\n        source: std::io::Error,\n    },\n    #[error(\"failed to seek policy file {path}: {source}\")]\n    SeekPolicyFile {\n        path: PathBuf,\n        source: std::io::Error,\n    },\n    #[error(\"failed to read policy file {path}: {source}\")]\n    ReadPolicyFile {\n        path: PathBuf,\n        source: std::io::Error,\n    },\n    #[error(\"failed to read metadata for policy file {path}: {source}\")]\n    PolicyMetadata {\n        path: PathBuf,\n        source: std::io::Error,\n    },\n}\n\n/// Note this thread uses advisory file locking and performs blocking I/O, so it should be used with\n/// [&#96;tokio::task::spawn_blocking&#96;] when called from an async context.\npub fn blocking_append_allow_prefix_rule(\n    policy_path: &amp;Path,\n    prefix: &amp;[String],\n) -&gt; Result&lt;(), AmendError&gt;",

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\config-secure.toml",

          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 127
          }
        },
        "contents": "warn_before_expiry_days = 14  # 14日前に警告\n\n[security.signing]\n# Ed25519署名鍵（メッセージ署名用）\nalgorithm = \"Ed25519\"\nsigning_key = \"~/.codex/keys/ed25519-signing\"\nsigning_public_key = \"~/.codex/keys/ed25519-signing.pub\"\n\n[security.encryption]\n# ペイロード暗号化\nalgorithm = \"AES-256-GCM\"\nkey_derivation = \"HKDF-SHA256\"\nkey_rotation_days = 90\n\n[security.replay_protection]\n# リプレイ攻撃対策\nenabled = true\nnonce_store = \"redis\"  # \"redis\" or \"memory\" (for testing)\nredis_url = \"redis://localhost:6379\"\ntimestamp_tolerance_sec = 300  # 5分以内のメッセージのみ受け入れ\n\n[security.rate_limiting]\n# Rate Limiting（DDoS対策）\nenabled = true\nmax_requests_per_sec = 10.0\nburst_size = 20\n\n# ==================== Sandbox ====================\n[sandbox]\ndefault_mode = \"read-only\"  # デフォルトは読み取り専用\n\n[approval]\npolicy = \"on-request\"  # 危険な操作は都度承認\n\n# ==================== エージェント通信セキュリティ ====================\n[agent_security]\nencryption_enabled = true\nsigning_enabled = true\n\n[agent_security.encryption]\nalgorithm = \"AES-256-GCM\"\nkey_derivation = \"HKDF-SHA256\"\n\n[agent_security.signing]\nalgorithm = \"Ed25519\"\nkeys_directory = \"~/.codex/keys/agents\"\n\n# エージェント信頼関係（RBAC: Role-Based Access Control）\n[agent_security.trust]\n# 特権エージェント（すべてのエージェントと通信可能）\nprivileged_agents = [\"SecurityExpert\"]\n\n# CodeExpert: 限定的な通信\n[agent_security.trust.CodeExpert]\ncan_communicate_with = [\"General\", \"TestingExpert\", \"DocsExpert\"]\npermissions = [\"read\", \"write\"]\n\n# SecurityExpert: すべてのエージェントと通信可能（特権）\n[agent_security.trust.SecurityExpert]\ncan_communicate_with = [\"*\"]  # ワイルドカード\npermissions = [\"read\", \"write\", \"execute\", \"admin\"]\n\n# TestingExpert: 制限あり\n[agent_security.trust.TestingExpert]\ncan_communicate_with = [\"CodeExpert\", \"General\"]\npermissions = [\"read\", \"write\"]\n\n# DeepResearcher: 外部アクセス可能",

        "contents": "(version 1)\n\n; inspired by Chrome's sandbox policy:\n; https://source.chromium.org/chromium/chromium/src/+/main:sandbox/policy/mac/common.sb;l=273-319;drc=7b3962fe2e5fc9e2ee58000dc8fbf3429d84d3bd\n; https://source.chromium.org/chromium/chromium/src/+/main:sandbox/policy/mac/renderer.sb;l=64;drc=7b3962fe2e5fc9e2ee58000dc8fbf3429d84d3bd\n\n; start with closed-by-default\n(deny default)\n\n; child processes inherit the policy of their parent\n(allow process-exec)\n(allow process-fork)\n(allow signal (target same-sandbox))\n\n; Allow cf prefs to work.\n(allow user-preference-read)\n\n; process-info\n(allow process-info* (target same-sandbox))\n\n(allow file-write-data\n  (require-all\n    (path \"/dev/null\")\n    (vnode-type CHARACTER-DEVICE)))\n\n; sysctls permitted.\n(allow sysctl-read\n  (sysctl-name \"hw.activecpu\")\n  (sysctl-name \"hw.busfrequency_compat\")\n  (sysctl-name \"hw.byteorder\")\n  (sysctl-name \"hw.cacheconfig\")\n  (sysctl-name \"hw.cachelinesize_compat\")\n  (sysctl-name \"hw.cpufamily\")\n  (sysctl-name \"hw.cpufrequency_compat\")\n  (sysctl-name \"hw.cputype\")\n  (sysctl-name \"hw.l1dcachesize_compat\")\n  (sysctl-name \"hw.l1icachesize_compat\")\n  (sysctl-name \"hw.l2cachesize_compat\")\n  (sysctl-name \"hw.l3cachesize_compat\")\n  (sysctl-name \"hw.logicalcpu_max\")\n  (sysctl-name \"hw.machine\")\n  (sysctl-name \"hw.memsize\")\n  (sysctl-name \"hw.ncpu\")\n  (sysctl-name \"hw.nperflevels\")\n  ; Chrome locks these CPU feature detection down a bit more tightly,\n  ; but mostly for fingerprinting concerns which isn't an issue for codex.\n  (sysctl-name-prefix \"hw.optional.arm.\")\n  (sysctl-name-prefix \"hw.optional.armv8_\")\n  (sysctl-name \"hw.packages\")\n  (sysctl-name \"hw.pagesize_compat\")\n  (sysctl-name \"hw.pagesize\")\n  (sysctl-name \"hw.physicalcpu\")\n  (sysctl-name \"hw.physicalcpu_max\")\n  (sysctl-name \"hw.tbfrequency_compat\")\n  (sysctl-name \"hw.vectorunit\")\n  (sysctl-name \"kern.argmax\")\n  (sysctl-name \"kern.hostname\")\n  (sysctl-name \"kern.maxfilesperproc\")\n  (sysctl-name \"kern.maxproc\")\n  (sysctl-name \"kern.osproductversion\")\n  (sysctl-name \"kern.osrelease\")",

        "contents": "name: linux-code-sign\ndescription: Sign Linux artifacts with cosign.\ninputs:\n  target:\n    description: Target triple for the artifacts to sign.\n    required: true\n  artifacts-dir:\n    description: Absolute path to the directory containing built binaries to sign.\n    required: true\n\nruns:\n  using: composite\n  steps:\n    - name: Install cosign\n      uses: sigstore/cosign-installer@v3.7.0\n\n    - name: Cosign Linux artifacts\n      shell: bash\n      env:\n        COSIGN_EXPERIMENTAL: \"1\"\n        COSIGN_YES: \"true\"\n        COSIGN_OIDC_CLIENT_ID: \"sigstore\"\n        COSIGN_OIDC_ISSUER: \"https://oauth2.sigstore.dev/auth\"\n      run: |\n        set -euo pipefail\n\n        dest=\"${{ inputs.artifacts-dir }}\"\n        if [[ ! -d \"$dest\" ]]; then\n          echo \"Destination $dest does not exist\"\n          exit 1\n        fi\n\n        for binary in codex codex-responses-api-proxy; do\n          artifact=\"${dest}/${binary}\"\n          if [[ ! -f \"$artifact\" ]]; then\n            echo \"Binary $artifact not found\"\n            exit 1\n          fi\n\n          cosign sign-blob \\\n            --yes \\\n            --bundle \"${artifact}.sigstore\" \\\n            \"$artifact\"\n        done",

        "contents": "      - name: Upload release notes\n        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4\n        with:\n          name: release-notes\n          path: RELEASE_NOTES.md\n\n  # ========== GitHub Release作成 ==========\n  create-release:\n    name: Create GitHub Release\n    runs-on: ubuntu-latest\n    needs: [build-release, npm-package, generate-release-notes]\n    timeout-minutes: 15\n    permissions:\n      contents: write\n\n    steps:\n      - name: Checkout repository\n        uses: actions/checkout@v5\n\n      - name: Download all artifacts\n        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4\n        with:\n          path: artifacts\n\n      - name: Create Release\n        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2\n        with:\n          tag_name: ${{ github.ref_name || format('v{0}', github.event.inputs.version) }}\n          name: zapabob/codex ${{ github.ref_name || github.event.inputs.version }}\n          body_path: artifacts/release-notes/RELEASE_NOTES.md\n          files: |\n            artifacts/codex-linux-x64/*\n            artifacts/codex-windows-x64/*\n            artifacts/codex-macos-x64/*\n            artifacts/codex-macos-arm64/*\n            artifacts/npm-package/*.tgz\n          draft: false\n          prerelease: true\n        env:\n          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}\n\n  # ========== npm公開（オプション） ==========\n  publish-npm:\n    name: Publish to npm (Optional)\n    runs-on: ubuntu-latest\n    needs: [create-release]\n    if: github.event_name == 'push' &amp;&amp; startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v')\n    timeout-minutes: 10\n\n    steps:\n      - name: Checkout repository\n        uses: actions/checkout@v5\n\n      ",

        "contents": "\";\nconst LATEST_RELEASE_URL: &amp;str = \"https://api.github.com/repos/openai/codex/releases/latest\";\n\n#[derive(Deserialize, Debug, Clone)]\nstruct ReleaseInfo {\n    tag_name: String,\n}\n\nfn version_filepath(config: &amp;Config) -&gt; PathBuf {\n    config.codex_home.join(VERSION_FILENAME)\n}\n\nfn read_version_info(version_file: &amp;Path) -&gt; anyhow::Result&lt;VersionInfo&gt; {\n    let contents = std::fs::read_to_string(version_file)?;\n    Ok(serde_json::from_str(&amp;contents)?)\n}\n\nasync fn check_for_update(version_file: &amp;Path) -&gt; anyhow::Result&lt;()&gt; {\n    let latest_version = match update_action::get_update_action() {\n        Some(UpdateAction::BrewUpgrade) =&gt; {\n            let cask_contents = create_client()\n                .get(HOMEBREW_CASK_URL)\n                .send()\n                .await?\n                .error_for_status()?\n                .text()\n                .await?;\n            extract_version_from_cask(&amp;cask_contents)?\n        }\n        _ =&gt; {\n            let ReleaseInfo {\n                tag_name: latest_tag_name,\n            } = create_client()\n                .get(LATEST_RELEASE_URL)\n                .send()\n                .await?\n                .error_for_status()?\n                .json::&lt;ReleaseInfo&gt;()\n                .await?;\n            extract_version_from_latest_tag(&amp;latest_tag_name)?\n        }\n    };\n\n    // Preserve any previously dismissed version if present.\n    let prev_info = read_version_info(version_file).ok();\n    let info = VersionInfo {\n        latest_version,\n        last_checked_at: Utc::now(),\n        dismissed_version: prev_info.and_then(|p| p.dismissed_version),\n    };\n\n    let json_line = format!(\"{}\\n\", serde_json::to_string(&amp;info)?);\n    if let Some(parent) = version_file.parent() {\n        tokio::fs::create_dir_all(parent).await?;\n    }\n    tokio::fs::write(version_file, json_line).await?;\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn is_newer(latest: &amp;str, current: &amp;str) -&gt; Option&lt;bool&gt;",

        "contents": "        }\n    }\n\n    async fn login_api_key_common(\n        &amp;mut self,\n        params: &amp;LoginApiKeyParams,\n    ) -&gt; std::result::Result&lt;(), JSONRPCErrorError&gt; {\n        if matches!(\n            self.config.forced_login_method,\n            Some(ForcedLoginMethod::Chatgpt)\n        ) {\n            return Err(JSONRPCErrorError {\n                code: INVALID_REQUEST_ERROR_CODE,\n                message: \"API key login is disabled. Use ChatGPT login instead.\".to_string(),\n                data: None,\n            });\n        }\n\n        // Cancel any active login attempt.\n        {\n            let mut guard = self.active_login.lock().await;\n            if let Some(active) = guard.take() {\n                drop(active);\n            }\n        }\n\n        match login_with_api_key(\n            &amp;self.config.codex_home,\n            &amp;params.api_key,\n            self.config.cli_auth_credentials_store_mode,\n        ) {\n            Ok(()) =&gt; {\n                self.auth_manager.reload();\n                Ok(())\n            }\n            Err(err) =&gt; Err(JSONRPCErrorError {\n                code: INTERNAL_ERROR_CODE,\n                message: format!(\"failed to save api key: {err}\"),\n                data: None,\n            }),\n        }\n    }\n\n    async fn login_api_key_v1(&amp;mut self, request_id: RequestId, params: LoginApiKeyParams) {\n        match self.login_api_key_common(&amp;params).await {\n            Ok(()) =&gt; {\n                self.outgoing\n                    .send_response(request_id, LoginApiKeyResponse {})\n                    .await;\n\n                let payload = AuthStatusChangeNotification {\n                    auth_method: self.auth_manager.auth().map(|auth| auth.mode),\n                };\n                self.outgoing\n                    .send_server_notification(ServerNotification::AuthStatusChange(payload))\n                    .await;\n            }\n            Err(error) =&gt; {\n                self.outgoing.send_error(request_id, error).await;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    async fn login_api_key_v2",

        "contents": "2. **API互換性問題**: OpenAI Responses API が特定のフォーマットを要求している可能性\n   - &#96;base_instructions_override&#96; が正しく処理されていない\n   - APIバージョンの不一致\n\n3. **環境設定**: ユーザーの設定ファイルが Responses API を使用している可能性\n   - デフォルトは Chat Completions API (&#96;wire_api = \"chat\"&#96;)\n   - ユーザー設定で上書きされている可能性\n\n### 確認済み事項\n\n✅ &#96;get_full_instructions()&#96; は正しく &#96;base_instructions_override&#96; を処理  \n✅ Chat Completions API はシステムメッセージとして送信  \n✅ YAML パースは正常に動作（&#96;instructions&#96; フィールド読み込み可能）\n\n---\n\n## 📝 次のステップ（未実施）\n\n### 1. インストール実行\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncargo install --path ./codex-rs/cli --force\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**問題**: &#96;ring&#96; クレートのビルドエラー（MSVC コンパイラクラッシュ）\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nerror: failed to run custom build command for &#96;ring v0.17.14&#96;\nexit code: 0xc0000005 (ACCESS_VIOLATION)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 2. デバッグログ確認\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\n$env:RUST_LOG=\"debug\"\ncodex delegate code-reviewer --scope ./codex-rs/cli/src\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n→ ログ出力されず（環境変数が反映されていない可能性）\n\n### 3. API 通信内容の確認\n\nリクエストボディに &#96;instructions&#96; が正しく含まれているか確認する必要がある。\n\n---\n\n## 🎯 推奨される追加調査\n\n1. **ネットワークログ取得**:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;rust\n   // reqwest クライアントのログを有効化\n   env_logger::init();\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n2. **API レスポンス詳細確認**:\n   エラーレスポンスの完全なボディを取得\n\n3. **モデルプロバイダー確認**:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   codex --help | grep model\n   cat ~/.codex/config.toml | grep wire_api\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n4. **代替テスト**:\n   - Chat Completions API を明示的に指定",

        "contents": "2. **API互換性問題**: OpenAI Responses API が特定のフォーマットを要求している可能性\n   - &#96;base_instructions_override&#96; が正しく処理されていない\n   - APIバージョンの不一致\n\n3. **環境設定**: ユーザーの設定ファイルが Responses API を使用している可能性\n   - デフォルトは Chat Completions API (&#96;wire_api = \"chat\"&#96;)\n   - ユーザー設定で上書きされている可能性\n\n### 確認済み事項\n\n✅ &#96;get_full_instructions()&#96; は正しく &#96;base_instructions_override&#96; を処理  \n✅ Chat Completions API はシステムメッセージとして送信  \n✅ YAML パースは正常に動作（&#96;instructions&#96; フィールド読み込み可能）\n\n---\n\n## 📝 次のステップ（未実施）\n\n### 1. インストール実行\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncargo install --path ./codex-rs/cli --force\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**問題**: &#96;ring&#96; クレートのビルドエラー（MSVC コンパイラクラッシュ）\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nerror: failed to run custom build command for &#96;ring v0.17.14&#96;\nexit code: 0xc0000005 (ACCESS_VIOLATION)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 2. デバッグログ確認\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\n$env:RUST_LOG=\"debug\"\ncodex delegate code-reviewer --scope ./codex-rs/cli/src\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n→ ログ出力されず（環境変数が反映されていない可能性）\n\n### 3.       "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\codex-rs\\cli\\src\\login.rs",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {
            "line": 63,
            "column": 1
          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 124,
            "column": 6
          }
        },
        "contents": "pub async fn run_login_with_api_key(\n    cli_config_overrides: CliConfigOverrides,\n    api_key: String,\n) -&gt; ! {\n    let config = load_config_or_exit(cli_config_overrides).await;\n\n    if matches!(config.forced_login_method, Some(ForcedLoginMethod::Chatgpt)) {\n        eprintln!(\"API key login is disabled. Use ChatGPT login instead.\");\n        std::process::exit(1);\n    }\n\n    match login_with_api_key(\n        &amp;config.codex_home,\n        &amp;api_key,\n        config.cli_auth_credentials_store_mode,\n    ) {\n        Ok(_) =&gt; {\n            eprintln!(\"Successfully logged in\");\n            std::process::exit(0);\n        }\n        Err(e) =&gt; {\n            eprintln!(\"Error logging in: {e}\");\n            std::process::exit(1);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\npub fn read_api_key_from_stdin() -&gt; String {\n    let mut stdin = std::io::stdin();\n\n    if stdin.is_terminal() {\n        eprintln!(\n            \"--with-api-key expects the API key on stdin. Try piping it, e.g. &#96;printenv OPENAI_API_KEY | codex login --with-api-key&#96;.\"\n        );\n        std::process::exit(1);\n    }\n\n    eprintln!(\"Reading API key from stdin...\");\n\n    let mut buffer = String::new();\n    if let Err(err) = stdin.read_to_string(&amp;mut buffer) {\n        eprintln!(\"Failed to read API key from stdin: {err}\");\n        std::process::exit(1);\n    }\n\n    let api_key = buffer.trim().to_string();\n    if api_key.is_empty() {\n        eprintln!(\"No API key provided via stdin.\");\n        std::process::exit(1);\n    }\n\n    api_key\n}\n\n/// Login using the OAuth device code flow.\npub async fn run_login_with_device_code(\n    cli_config_overrides: CliConfigOverrides,\n    issuer_base_url: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n    client_id: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n) -&gt; !",

        "contents": "# Codex v2.0.0 Environment Variables Sample\n# このファイルを .env にコピーして実際の値を設定してください\n\n# ==================== 必須（Required） ====================\n\n# OpenAI API Key - メインのLLM接続に必要\n# 取得方法: https://platform.openai.com/api-keys\nOPENAI_API_KEY=sk-proj-your-api-key-here\n\n# ==================== オプション（Optional） ====================\n\n# GitHub Personal Access Token - GitHub MCP Server、コード連携用\n# 取得方法: https://github.com/settings/tokens\n# 権限: repo, read:org\nGITHUB_TOKEN=ghp_your_github_token_here\n\n# Slack Webhook URL - 通知・監視用\n# 取得方法: https://api.slack.com/messaging/webhooks\nSLACK_WEBHOOK_URL=https://hooks.slack.com/services/YOUR/WEBHOOK/URL\n\n# Brave Search API Key - Web検索用（Deep Research）\n# 取得方法: https://brave.com/search/api/\nBRAVE_API_KEY=your_brave_api_key_here\n\n# ==================== GPU加速（GPU Acceleration） ====================\n\n# CUDA Device ID - 使用するGPUデバイス番号（デフォルト: 0）\nCUDA_DEVICE=0\n\n# ==================== ログ・デバッグ（Logging &amp; Debug） ====================\n\n# Rust Log Level - ログレベル設定\nRUST_LOG=info\n\n# ==================== 使用例（Usage Examples） ====================\n\n# CUDA加速:\n#   codex --use-cuda \"Analyze codebase\"\n#\n# Windows AI加速:\n#   codex --use-windows-ai \"Your task\"\n#\n# git解析（CUDA、100,000コミット）:\n#   codex git-analyze commits --use-cuda --limit 100000",

        "contents": "use std::path::Path;\nuse std::path::PathBuf;\nuse std::time::Duration;\n\nuse rand::Rng;\nuse tracing::debug;\nuse tracing::error;\n\nconst INITIAL_DELAY_MS: u64 = 200;\nconst BACKOFF_FACTOR: f64 = 2.0;\n\npub(crate) fn backoff(attempt: u64) -&gt; Duration {\n    let exp = BACKOFF_FACTOR.powi(attempt.saturating_sub(1) as i32);\n    let base = (INITIAL_DELAY_MS as f64 * exp) as u64;\n    let jitter = rand::rng().random_range(0.9..1.1);\n    Duration::from_millis((base as f64 * jitter) as u64)\n}\n\npub(crate) fn error_or_panic(message: impl std::string::ToString) {\n    if cfg!(debug_assertions) {\n        panic!(\"{}\", message.to_string());\n    } else {\n        error!(\"{}\", message.to_string());\n    }\n}\n\npub(crate) fn try_parse_error_message(text: &amp;str) -&gt; String {\n    debug!(\"Parsing server error response: {}\", text);\n    let json = serde_json::from_str::&lt;serde_json::Value&gt;(text).unwrap_or_default();\n    if let Some(error) = json.get(\"error\")\n        &amp;&amp; let Some(message) = error.get(\"message\")\n        &amp;&amp; let Some(message_str) = message.as_str()\n    {\n        return message_str.to_string();\n    }\n    if text.is_empty() {\n        return \"Unknown error\".to_string();\n    }\n    text.to_string()\n}\n\npub fn resolve_path(base: &amp;Path, path: &amp;PathBuf) -&gt; PathBuf {\n    if path.is_absolute() {\n        path.clone()\n    } else {\n        base.join(path)\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n\n    #[test]",

      "codeBlock": {

          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 166
          }
        },
        "contents": "# 用途: 設定ファイル、認証情報、ログの保存先\n# CODEX_HOME=\n\n# Rustログレベル（デフォルト: info）\n# 選択肢: error, warn, info, debug, trace\n# 用途: デバッグ時に詳細ログを出力\nRUST_LOG=info\n\n# ==================== 開発・デバッグ用（任意） ====================\n\n# デバッグモード（1で有効化）\n# 用途: 詳細なデバッグ情報を出力\n# DEBUG=\n\n# ログの詳細レベル\n# 用途: より詳細なログを出力\n# VERBOSE=\n\n# ==================== 使用例 ====================\n\n# 【パターン1】最小構成（OpenAIのみ）:\n# CODEX_API_KEY=sk-proj-XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX\n\n# 【パターン2】標準構成（GitHub連携込み）:\n# CODEX_API_KEY=sk-proj-XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX\n# GITHUB_TOKEN=ghp_XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX\n\n# 【パターン3】フル機能構成（すべてのMCPサーバー有効化）:\n# CODEX_API_KEY=sk-proj-XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX\n# OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-proj-XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX\n# GITHUB_TOKEN=ghp_XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX\n# GEMINI_API_KEY=AIzaSyXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX\n# BRAVE_API_KEY=BSA_XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX\n# SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL=https://hooks.slack.com/services/XXX/XXX/XXX\n# RUST_LOG=info\n\n# ==================== 読み込み方法 ====================\n\n# 【方法1】PowerShell（Windows）\n# 現在のセッションに読み込み:\nGet-Content .env | ForEach-Object {\n    if ($_ -match '^([^#][^=]+)=(.*)$') {\n        [System.Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable($matches[1].Trim(), $matches[2].Trim(), \"Process\")\n    }\n}\n\n# 【方法2】Bash/Zsh（Linux/macOS）\n# 現在のシェルに読み込み:\nset -a\nsource .env\nset +a\n\n# 【方法3】専用スクリプト使用（推奨）\n# PowerShell: .\\zapabob\\scripts\\load-env.ps1\n# Bash: source zapabob/scripts/load-env.sh\n\n# 【方法4】自動読み込みツール\n# - direnv: https://direnv.net/\n#   .envrc ファイルに「dotenv」と記述するだけで自動読み込み\n# - dotenv (Node.js): https://www.npmjs.com/package/dotenv\n#   require('dotenv').config() で読み込み",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# 用途: 設定ファイル、認証情報、ログの保存先",
            "lineNumber": 105
          },

        "contents": "# Deep Research 検索品質問題 - 分析と修正\n\n**報告日時**: 2025-10-22  \n**影響バージョン**: zapabob/codex v0.48.0-zapabob.1  \n**問題種別**: 検索品質低下（404ページ取得）\n\n---\n\n## 🐛 問題の概要\n\n### 症状\n\nDeep Research機能（&#96;codex research&#96;）で検索を実行すると：\n\n**問題**:\n- ✅ コマンド自体は正常動作\n- ❌ **404ページのHTMLばかり取得**\n- ❌ 実用的な情報が得られない\n- ❌ URLデコードに問題（&#96;&amp;rut=&#96;パラメータが残る）\n\n**実行例**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncodex research \"Rust async error handling best practices\" --depth 2 --breadth 5\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**結果**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nSources found: 5\nしかし全て404ページ:\n- \"PAGE NOT FOUND 404 Out of nothing, something...\"\n- \"404 Page not found | Markaicode\"\n- \"The page you were looking for doesn't exist (404)\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## 🔍 根本原因の分析\n\n### 1. DuckDuckGo無料版の品質問題\n\n**現在の実装** (codex-rs/cli/src/research_cmd.rs:69-87):\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;rust\n// フォールバックチェーン: Brave &gt; Google &gt; Bing &gt; DuckDuckGo (APIキー不要)\nif std::env::var(\"BRAVE_API_KEY\").is_ok() {\n    println!(\"   ✅ Brave Search API detected\");\n} else if std::env::var(\"GOOGLE_API_KEY\").is_ok() &amp;&amp; std::env::var(\"GOOGLE_CSE_ID\").is_ok() {\n    println!(\"   ✅ Google Custom Search API detected\");\n} else if std::env::var(\"BING_API_KEY\").is_ok() {\n    println!(\"   ✅ Bing Web Search API detected\");\n} else {\n    println!(\"   🔓 No API keys found, using DuckDuckGo (free, no API key required)\");\n}\n\nArc::new(WebSearchProvider::new(3, 30))\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**問題点**:\n- DuckDuckGoは**無料だが品質が低い**\n- 404ページやリダイレクトページを「関連情報」として取得\n- APIキーの設定がないため、デフォルトでDuckDuckGo使用\n\n---\n\n### 2. URLデコード問題\n\n**デバッグログから**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n🔗 [DEBUG] Decoded URL: //duckduckgo.com/l/?uddg=https%3A%2F%2Fmedium.com%2F%40adamszpilewicz%2Ferror%2Dhandling%2Din%2Dasync%2Drust%2Dbest%2Dpractices%2Dfor%2Dreal%2Dprojects%2D46a2cce1cecc&amp;rut=99373327ff715cdd49fa12b60c720921e9e49258f4967d83a07db14ae4b36fc1\n→ https://medium.com/@adamszpilewicz/error-handling-in-async-rust-best-practices-for-real-projects-46a2cce1cecc&amp;rut=99373327ff715cdd49fa12b60c720921e9e49258f4967d83a07db14ae4b36fc1",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "# Deep Research 検索品質問題 - 分析と修正\n\n**報告日時**: 2025-10-22  \n**影響バージョン**: zapabob/codex v0.48.0-zapabob.1  \n**問題種別**: 検索品質低下（404ページ取得）\n\n---\n\n## 🐛 問題の概要\n\n### 症状\n\nDeep Research機能（&#96;codex research&#96;）で検索を実行すると：\n\n**問題**:\n- ✅ コマンド自体は正常動作\n- ❌ **404ページのHTMLばかり取得**\n- ❌ 実用的な情報が得られない\n- ❌ URLデコードに問題（&#96;&amp;rut=&#96;パラメータが残る）\n\n**実行例**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncodex research \"Rust async error handling best practices\" --depth 2 --breadth 5\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**結果**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nSources found: 5\nしかし全て404ページ:\n- \"PAGE NOT FOUND 404 Out of nothing, something...\"\n- \"404 Page not found | Markaicode\"\n- \"The page you were looking for doesn't exist (404)\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## 🔍 根本原因の分析\n\n### 1. DuckDuckGo無料版の品質問題\n\n**現在の実装** (codex-rs/cli/src/research_cmd.rs:69-87):\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;rust\n// フォールバックチェーン: Brave &gt; Google &gt; Bing &gt; DuckDuckGo (APIキー不要)\nif std::env::var(\"BRAVE_API_KEY\").is_ok() {\n    println!(\"   ✅ Brave Search API detected\");\n} else if std::env::var(\"GOOGLE_API_KEY\").is_ok() &amp;&amp; std::env::var(\"GOOGLE_CSE_ID\").is_ok() {\n    println!(\"   ✅ Google Custom Search API detected\");\n} else if std::env::var(\"BING_API_KEY\").is_ok() {\n    println!(\"   ✅ Bing Web Search API detected\");\n} else {\n    println!(\"   🔓 No API keys found, using DuckDuckGo (free, no API key required)\");\n}\n\nArc::new(WebSearchProvider::new(3, 30))\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**問題点**:\n- DuckDuckGoは**無料だが品質が低い**\n- 404ページやリダイレクトページを「関連情報」として取得\n- APIキーの設定がないため、デフォルトでDuckDuckGo使用\n\n---\n\n### 2. 攻撃者視点のセキュリティ脆弱性監査と改善を完了しました。

## 実装完了内容

### 1. コマンドインジェクション対策
- `install-binary.js`: `exec()`を`spawn()`に変更し、パラメータ化されたコマンド実行を実装
- `user_shell.rs`: 危険なコマンド（`rm -rf`、`sudo`など）を事前にブロック

### 2. パストラバーサル対策
- `orchestrator/src/server.rs`: ベースディレクトリ制限を追加し、許可されたディレクトリ内のみアクセス可能に

### 3. バイナリ配布の改ざんリスク対策
- `install-binary.js`: SHA256チェックサム検証、リダイレクト制限、ホスト名検証を実装

### 4. 認証・認可フレームワーク
- `orchestrator/src/server.rs`: 認証チェックのフレームワークを追加（実装はプレースホルダー）

### 5. 機密情報漏洩対策
- `core/src/security/secret_masking.rs`: APIキー、トークン、パスワードをマスクする機能を実装
- エラーメッセージとログ出力で自動マスキング

### 6-8. その他の対策
- サンドボックス回避対策: 既存実装を確認
- ネットワーク通信セキュリティ: TLS検証を強化
- 依存関係の脆弱性スキャン: 手動実行を推奨（CI/CD統合推奨）

実装ログは`_docs/2025-12-30_攻撃者視点セキュリティ脆弱性監査と改善実装完了{main}.md`に保存しました。

        "contents": "# Codex Cloud API設計書\n\n**バージョン**: v1.0.0  \n**最終更新**: 2025年11月2日  \n**目的**: Codex Cloud SaaS APIの完全な設計仕様\n\n---\n\n## 📋 目次\n\n1. [アーキテクチャ概要](#architecture)\n2. [認証 &amp; 認可](#auth)\n3. [エージェント実行](#agents)\n4. [可視化エンドポイント](#visualization)\n5. [サブスクリプション管理](#subscription)\n6. [WebSocket](#websocket)\n7. [Rate Limiting](#rate-limiting)\n8. [エラーハンドリング](#errors)\n\n---\n\n## &lt;a name=\"architecture\"&gt;&lt;/a&gt;🏗️ アーキテクチャ概要\n\n### スタック\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nClient (Browser/IDE/CLI)\n    ↓ HTTPS/WSS\n[ API Gateway - AWS ALB/CloudFlare ]\n    ↓\n[ Rust Backend - axum ]\n    ├── Authentication (JWT + Auth0)\n    ├── Agent Orchestrator\n    ├── Visualization Service\n    └── Subscription Manager\n    ↓\n[ GPU Cluster - Kubernetes ]\n[ PostgreSQL - User data ]\n[ Redis - Session/Cache ]\n[ S3 - Artifacts ]\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Base URL\n\n- **Production**: &#96;https://api.codex.ai&#96;\n- **Staging**: &#96;https://api-staging.codex.ai&#96;\n- **Development**: &#96;http://localhost:8080&#96;\n\n### API Versioning\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nhttps://api.codex.ai/v1/{endpoint}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Content Type\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nContent-Type: application/json\nAccept: application/json\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## &lt;a name=\"auth\"&gt;&lt;/a&gt;🔐 認証 &amp; 認可\n\n### 認証フロー\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;mermaid\nsequenceDiagram\n    Client-&gt;&gt;+Auth0: Login (email/password)\n    Auth0-&gt;&gt;+Client: ID Token (JWT)\n    Client-&gt;&gt;+Codex API: Request + Authorization header\n    Codex API-&gt;&gt;+Auth0: Validate token\n    Auth0-&gt;&gt;+Codex API: User info\n    Codex API-&gt;&gt;+Client: Response\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### JWT Structure\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"sub\": \"auth0|507f1f77bcf86cd799439011\",\n  \"email\": \"user@example.com\",\n  \"email_verified\": true,\n  \"iss\": \"https://codex.auth0.com/\",\n  \"aud\": \"https://api.codex.ai\",\n  \"iat\": 1699999999,\n  \"exp\": 1700086399,\n  \"azp\": \"CLIENT_ID\",\n  \"scope\": \"openid profile email\",\n  \"codex_tier\": \"pro\",\n  \"codex_subscription_id\": \"sub_1ABC...\"\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### API Key (Alternative)\n\nFor CLI/automation:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",

        "contents": "serve(async (req: Request) =&gt; {\n  // Handle CORS preflight\n  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {\n    return new Response(null, { headers: corsHeaders })\n  }\n\n  try {\n    const { provider } = await req.json()\n\n    // Get authorization header\n    const authHeader = req.headers.get('Authorization')\n    if (!authHeader) {\n      throw new Error('No authorization header')\n    }\n\n    // Create Supabase client\n    const supabase = createClient(\n      Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL') ?? '',\n      Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_ANON_KEY') ?? '',\n      { global: { headers: { Authorization: authHeader } } }\n    )\n\n    // Get user\n    const {\n      data: { user },\n    } = await supabase.auth.getUser()\n\n    if (!user) {\n      throw new Error('Unauthorized')\n    }\n\n    // Query API key\n    const { data, error } = await supabase\n      .from('api_keys')\n      .select('encrypted_key')\n      .eq('user_id', user.id)\n      .eq('provider', provider)\n      .single()\n\n    if (error) {\n      throw error\n    }\n\n    // Decrypt API key\n    const encryptionKey = Deno.env.get('ENCRYPTION_KEY') ?? 'default-key-change-in-prod'\n    const decryptedKey = await decrypt(data.encrypted_key, encryptionKey)\n\n    return new Response(\n      JSON.stringify({ api_key: decryptedKey }),\n      {\n        headers: { ...corsHeaders, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },\n      }\n    )\n  } catch (error) {\n    return new Response(\n      JSON.stringify({ error: error.message }),\n      {\n        status: 400,\n        headers: { ...corsHeaders, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },\n      }\n    )\n  }\n})",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "serve(async (req: Request) =&gt; {\n  // Handle CORS preflight\n  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {\n    return new Response(null, { headers: corsHeaders })\n  }\n\n  try {\n    const { provider } = await req.json()\n\n    // Get authorization header\n    const authHeader = req.headers.get('Authorization')\n    if (!authHeader) {\n      throw new Error('No authorization header')\n    }\n\n    // Create Supabase client\n    const supabase = createClient(\n      Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL') ?? '',\n      { global: { headers: { Authorization: authHeader } } }\n    )\n\n    // Get user\n    const {\n      data: { user },\n    } = await supabase.auth.getUser()\n\n    if (!user) {\n      throw new Error('Unauthorized')\n    }\n\n    // Query API key\n    const { data, error } = await supabase\n      .from('api_keys')\n      .select('encrypted_key')\n      .eq('user_id', user.id)\n      .eq('provider', provider)\n      .single()\n\n    if (error) {\n      throw error\n    }\n\n    // Decrypt API key\n    const encryptionKey = Deno.env.get('ENCRYPTION_KEY') ??         },
        "contents": "/**\n * Next.js Middleware\n * \n * Handles authentication and session management\n */\n\nimport { createMiddlewareClient } from '@supabase/auth-helpers-nextjs'\nimport { NextResponse } from 'next/server'\nimport type { NextRequest } from 'next/server'\n\nexport async function middleware(req: NextRequest) {\n  const res = NextResponse.next()\n  const supabase = createMiddlewareClient({ req, res })\n\n  const {\n    data: { session },\n  } = await supabase.auth.getSession()\n\n  // Protected routes\n  const protectedPaths = ['/dashboard', '/Plans', '/visualization', '/settings', '/usage']\n  const isProtectedPath = protectedPaths.some((path) =&gt; req.nextUrl.pathname.startsWith(path))\n\n  // Redirect to login if accessing protected route without session\n  if (isProtectedPath &amp;&amp; !session) {\n    return NextResponse.redirect(new URL('/login', req.url))\n  }\n\n  // Redirect to dashboard if accessing auth pages with session\n  const authPaths = ['/login', '/signup']\n  const isAuthPath = authPaths.some((path) =&gt; req.nextUrl.pathname.startsWith(path))\n\n  if (isAuthPath &amp;&amp; session) {\n    return NextResponse.redirect(new URL('/dashboard', req.url))\n  }\n\n  return res\n}\n\nexport const config = {\n  matcher: [\n    '/((?!_next/static|_next/image|favicon.ico|api).*)',\n  ],\n}",

        "range": {

        "contents": "# Gemini Authentication Guide\n\n## Overview\n\nCodex supports two authentication methods for Google's Gemini models:\n1. **API Key** (Google AI Studio) - Simple, recommended for development\n2. **OAuth 2.0** (Vertex AI) - Enterprise, supports Google Account authentication\n\n## Authentication Modes\n\n### API Key Mode (Google AI Studio)\n\n**Best for**: Development, testing, personal use\n\n**Setup**:\n\n1. Get your API key from [Google AI Studio](https://makersuite.google.com/app/apikey)\n\n2. Set environment variable:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   export GEMINI_API_KEY=your-api-key-here\n   # or\n   export GOOGLE_AI_STUDIO_API_KEY=your-api-key-here\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n3. Or add to &#96;.codex/config.toml&#96;:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;toml\n   [auth.gemini]\n   mode = \"api-key\"\n   provider = \"ai_studio\"\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Usage**:\n- API key is attached as &#96;x-goog-api-key&#96; header\n- Direct access to Generative Language API\n- No additional authentication steps required\n\n### OAuth 2.0 Mode (Vertex AI)\n\n**Best for**: Production, enterprise, team use\n\n**Requirements**:\n- Google Cloud Project with Vertex AI API enabled\n- OAuth 2.0 Client ID configured\n- Appropriate IAM permissions\n\n**Setup**:\n\n1. **Create Google Cloud Project**:\n   - Go to [Google Cloud Console](https://console.cloud.google.com/)\n   - Create or select a project\n   - Enable Vertex AI API\n\n2. **Configure OAuth 2.0**:\n   - Navigate to APIs &amp; Services &gt; Credentials\n   - Create OAuth 2.0 Client ID (Desktop application)\n   - Download credentials or note Client ID\n\n3. **Set environment variables**:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   export GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID=your-client-id.apps.googleusercontent.com\n   export GCP_PROJECT_ID=your-gcp-project-id\n   export VERTEX_REGION=us-central1\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n4. **Or configure in &#96;.codex/config.toml&#96;**:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;toml\n   [auth.gemini]\n   mode = \"oauth\"\n   provider = \"vertex\"\n   project = \"your-gcp-project-id\"\n   region = \"us-central1\"\n   prefer_cli = true  # Use geminicli if available\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Authentication Flow**:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Login (opens browser for Google Account authentication)\ncodex auth gemini login\n\n# Check status\ncodex auth gemini status\n\n# Logout",

        "contents": "# Prism デプロイメントガイド\n\n**最終更新**: 2025年11月2日\n\n---\n\n## 🚀 完全無料デプロイ手順\n\n### Phase 1: Supabase セットアップ\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# 1. Supabaseアカウント作成\nhttps://supabase.com にアクセス → Sign Up\n\n# 2. 新規プロジェクト作成\nOrganization: Personal\nProject name: prism-production\nDatabase Password: (強力なパスワード生成)\nRegion: Northeast Asia (Tokyo)\nPricing: Free Tier ✅\n\n# 3. SQL Editorでスキーマ実行\nDashboard → SQL Editor → New query\n→ supabase/schema.sql の内容を貼り付け → Run\n\n# 4. Storage Buckets作成\nDashboard → Storage → New bucket\n  - visualizations (public)\n  - avatars (public)\n  - artifacts (private)\n\n# 5. 認証設定\nDashboard → Authentication → Providers\n  ✅ Email (enabled)\n  ✅ GitHub OAuth (設定: https://github.com/settings/developers)\n\n# 6. APIキー取得\nDashboard → Settings → API\n  → Copy: Project URL, anon/public key\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Phase 2: GitHub リポジトリ\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# 1. GitHubで新規リポジトリ作成\nhttps://github.com/new\nRepository name: prism\nDescription: AI-Native Code Intelligence Platform\nPublic ✅\n\n# 2. ローカルからpush\ncd prism-web\ngit init\ngit add .\ngit commit -m \"feat: Initial Prism implementation\"\ngit branch -M main\ngit remote add origin https://github.com/YOUR_USERNAME/prism.git\ngit push -u origin main\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Phase 3: Vercel デプロイ\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# 1. Vercelアカウント作成\nhttps://vercel.com → Sign up with GitHub\n\n# 2. プロジェクトインポート\nDashboard → Add New → Project\n→ GitHubリポジトリ選択: prism\n\n# 3. 環境変数設定\nEnvironment Variables:\n  NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL = (Supabaseから取得)\n  NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY = (Supabaseから取得)\n  ENCRYPTION_SECRET = (32文字以上のランダム文字列)\n\n# 4. デプロイ設定\nFramework Preset: Next.js\nBuild Command: npm run build\nOutput Directory: .next\nInstall Command: npm install\n\n→ Deploy\n\n# 5. デプロイ完了\nYour project is live at: https://prism-xxx.vercel.app",

        "contents": "# Prism デプロイメントガイド\n\n**最終更新**: 2025年11月2日\n\n---\n\n## 🚀 完全無料デプロイ手順\n\n### Phase 1: Supabase セットアップ\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# 1. SQL Editorでスキーマ実行\nDashboard → SQL Editor → New query\n→ supabase/schema.sql の内容を貼り付け → Run\n\n# 4. Storage Buckets作成\nDashboard → Storage → New bucket\n  - visualizations (public)\n  - avatars (public)\n  - artifacts (private)\n\n# 5. 認証設定\nDashboard → Authentication → Providers\n  ✅ Email (enabled)\n  ✅ GitHub OAuth (設定: https://github.com/settings/developers)\n\n# 6. APIキー取得\nDashboard → Settings → API\n  → Copy: Project URL, anon/public key\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Phase 2: GitHub リポジトリ\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# 1.         "contents": "permissions = [\"read\", \"write\"]\n\n# DeepResearcher: 外部アクセス可能\n[agent_security.trust.DeepResearcher]\ncan_communicate_with = [\"General\"]\npermissions = [\"read\", \"network\"]\n\n# DocsExpert: ドキュメント生成のみ\n[agent_security.trust.DocsExpert]\ncan_communicate_with = [\"General\", \"CodeExpert\"]\npermissions = [\"read\", \"write\"]\n\n# DebugExpert: デバッグ権限\n[agent_security.trust.DebugExpert]\ncan_communicate_with = [\"General\", \"CodeExpert\"]\npermissions = [\"read\", \"write\", \"execute\"]\n\n# PerformanceExpert: パフォーマンス測定\n[agent_security.trust.PerformanceExpert]\ncan_communicate_with = [\"General\"]\npermissions = [\"read\"]\n\n# General: 汎用エージェント\n[agent_security.trust.General]\ncan_communicate_with = [\"*\"]\npermissions = [\"read\"]\n\n[agent_security.rate_limiting]\nenabled = true\nmax_messages_per_sec = 5.0\n\n# ==================== 監査ログ ====================\n[audit]\nenabled = true\nlog_dir = \"~/.codex/audit-logs\"\ninclude_mcp_calls = true\ninclude_agent_messages = true\ninclude_security_events = true\ninclude_tool_args = true\nformat = \"json\"\nrotation = \"daily\"\nretention_days = 90\n\n# セキュリティイベントの即時通知\n[audit.alerts]\nenabled = true\nalert_on_security_events = true\nalert_email = \"security@example.com\"\nalert_slack_webhook = \"${SLACK_SECURITY_WEBHOOK}\"\n\n# 重要イベントの閾値\n[audit.thresholds]\n# mTLS認証失敗が5分間に10回以上でアラート\nmtls_auth_failures_per_5min = 10\n# 署名検証失敗が5分間に5回以上でアラート\nsignature_failures_per_5min = 5\n# Rate Limit超過が5分間に100回以上でアラート\nrate_limit_exceeded_per_5min = 100\n\n# ==================== MCP サーバー（セキュア版） ====================\n# 🔒 すべてのMCPサーバーでTLS/mTLS有効化\n\n# Codex MCP Server - メインサーバー（TLS/mTLS）\n[mcp_servers.codex]\ncommand = \"codex\"\nargs = [\"mcp-server\"]\nenv.RUST_LOG = \"info\"\nenv.OPENAI_API_KEY = \"${OPENAI_API_KEY}\"\nenv.GITHUB_TOKEN = \"${GITHUB_TOKEN}\"\nenv.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL = \"${SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL}\"\nstartup_timeout_sec = 60",

        "contents": "# Chrome DevTools - ブラウザ自動化（TLS/mTLS）\n[mcp_servers.chrome-devtools]\ncommand = \"npx\"\nargs = [\"-y\", \"@modelcontextprotocol/server-chrome\"]\ntransport = \"https\"\nbind_address = \"127.0.0.1:8006\"\ntls_cert = \"~/.codex/certs/mcp-servers/chrome-devtools-cert.pem\"\ntls_key = \"~/.codex/certs/mcp-servers/chrome-devtools-key.pem\"\nrequire_client_cert = true\nauth_method = \"mtls\"\n\n# Sequential Thinking - 段階的思考（TLS/mTLS）\n[mcp_servers.sequential-thinking]\ncommand = \"npx\"\nargs = [\"-y\", \"@modelcontextprotocol/server-sequential-thinking\"]\ntransport = \"https\"\nbind_address = \"127.0.0.1:8007\"\ntls_cert = \"~/.codex/certs/mcp-servers/sequential-thinking-cert.pem\"\ntls_key = \"~/.codex/certs/mcp-servers/sequential-thinking-key.pem\"\nrequire_client_cert = true\nauth_method = \"mtls\"\n\n# ... (他のMCPサーバーも同様にTLS/mTLS設定)\n\n# ==================== サブエージェント ====================\n[subagents]\nenabled = true\nmax_parallel = 4\ntoken_budget = 40000\ninherit_model = true\nuse_codex_mcp = true\n\n# 🔐 セキュア通信有効化\nsecure_channel = true\nencryption_enabled = true\nsigning_enabled = true\n\n# ==================== Deep Research ====================\n[deep_research]\nenabled = true\ndefault_backend = \"gemini\"  # Gemini Search Grounding\nfallback_backends = [\"duckduckgo\", \"google\", \"bing\"]\nmax_sources = 10\ncitation_style = \"academic\"\n\n# ==================== セキュリティモニタリング ====================\n[monitoring]\nenabled = true\nprometheus_endpoint = \"http://localhost:9090\"\ngrafana_dashboard_url = \"http://localhost:3000/d/codex-security\"\n\n[monitoring.metrics]\n# 収集するメトリクス\ncollect_tls_metrics = true\ncollect_auth_metrics = true\ncollect_rate_limit_metrics = true\ncollect_agent_metrics = true\n\n[monitoring.export]\n# メトリクスのエクスポート\nformat = \"prometheus\"\nexport_interval_sec = 30\n\n# ==================== バックアップ ====================\n[backup]\nenabled = true\nbackup_dir = \"~/.codex/backups\"\nbackup_interval_hours = 24\nretention_days = 30\n\n# バックアップ対象",

        "contents": "You: @prism analyze this code for security issues\n\nClaude: [Uses Prism's AI analysis]\nFound 2 potential security issues:\n1. SQL injection risk in line 42\n2. Missing input validation in line 67\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## 💻 開発\n\n### ローカル開発\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Frontend\nnpm run dev         # http://localhost:3000\n\n# MCP Server\ncd prism-mcp-server\nnpm run dev         # Watch mode\n\n# Supabase local (optional)\nnpx supabase start  # Requires Docker\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### テスト\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Frontend tests\nnpm run test\n\n# Type check\nnpm run type-check\n\n# Lint\nnpm run lint\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### ビルド\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Production build\nnpm run build\n\n# Start production server\nnpm start\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## 🌐 デプロイ\n\n### Vercel（推奨）\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Install Vercel CLI\nnpm i -g vercel\n\n# Deploy\nvercel\n\n# Add environment variables\nvercel env add NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL\nvercel env add NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY\nvercel env add ENCRYPTION_SECRET\n\n# Deploy to production\nvercel --prod\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### カスタムドメイン\n\n1. Vercel Dashboard → Settings → Domains\n2. Add &#96;prism.dev&#96;\n3. Cloudflare DNSにCNAME追加\n\n---\n\n## 🔐 セキュリティ\n\n### APIキー保護\n\n- ✅ AES-256暗号化\n- ✅ Supabase Edge Functionsでサーバー側のみ処理\n- ✅ Row Level Security (RLS)\n- ✅ HTTPS必須\n\n### 環境変数\n\n**絶対にコミットしない**:\n- &#96;.env.local&#96;\n- &#96;ENCRYPTION_SECRET&#96;\n- API Keys\n\n---\n\n## 📊 Supabase無料枠制限\n\n| 項目 | 制限 |\n|------|-----|\n| Database | 500 MB |\n| Storage | 1 GB |\n| Bandwidth | 2 GB/月 |\n| Edge Functions | 500K呼び出し/月 |\n| Realtime | 同時接続200 |\n\n**対策**:\n- 大規模リポジトリは圧縮\n- 画像最適化\n- CDN使用（Vercel標準）\n\n---\n\n## 🤝 コントリビューション\n\nPRs welcome! See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)\n\n---\n\n## 📄 ライセンス\n\nApache 2.0 - See [LICENSE](../LICENSE)\n\n---\n\n## 🆘 サポート\n\n- Discord: https://discord.gg/prism\n- GitHub Issues: https://github.com/zapabob/prism/issues\n- Email: support@prism.dev",
