        "contents": "# 高速差分ビルドとインストールスクリプト（tqdm風進捗表示付き）\n# Rustのビルド進捗を視覚化して残り時間・経過時間を表示\n\nparam(\n    [switch]$Release = $true,\n    [switch]$Clean = $false\n)\n\n$ErrorActionPreference = \"Continue\"\n\n# ログファイルパス\n$logPath = \".cursor\\debug.log\"\n\n# ログ関数\nfunction Write-DebugLog {\n    param(\n        [string]$location,\n        [string]$message,\n        [hashtable]$data = @{},\n        [string]$hypothesisId = \"\"\n    )\n    $logEntry = @{\n        id = \"log_$(Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMddHHmmss')_$(New-Guid)\"\n        timestamp = [DateTimeOffset]::Now.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds()\n        location = $location\n        message = $message\n        data = $data\n        sessionId = \"debug-session\"\n        runId = \"build-install\"\n        hypothesisId = $hypothesisId\n    } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress\n    Add-Content -Path $logPath -Value $logEntry -Encoding UTF8 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\n}\n\nWrite-DebugLog -location \"fast-build-install.ps1:1\" -message \"高速差分ビルド開始\" -data @{release = $Release; clean = $Clean} -hypothesisId \"A\"\n\nWrite-Host \"========================================\" -ForegroundColor Cyan\nWrite-Host \" Codex 高速差分ビルド &amp; インストール\" -ForegroundColor Cyan\nWrite-Host \"========================================\" -ForegroundColor Cyan\nWrite-Host \"\"\n\n# システム情報\n$cpuCores = (Get-WmiObject Win32_Processor).NumberOfLogicalProcessors\nWrite-Host \"CPU Cores: $cpuCores\" -ForegroundColor White\nWrite-Host \"Build Mode: $(if ($Release) { 'Release' } else { 'Debug' })\" -ForegroundColor White\nWrite-Host \"\"\n\nSet-Location codex-rs\n\nif ($Clean) {\n    Write-Host \"Cleaning build cache...\" -ForegroundColor Yellow\n    cargo clean\n    Write-Host \"Clean complete!\" -ForegroundColor Green\n    Write-Host \"\"\n}\n\n# ビルド開始時刻\n$buildStart = Get-Date\nWrite-DebugLog -location \"fast-build-install.ps1:2\" -message \"ビルド開始\" -data @{startTime = $buildStart.ToString(\"yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss\")} -hypothesisId \"A\"\n\nWrite-Host \"Starting incremental build...\" -ForegroundColor Yellow",

        "contents": "# 実機テストスクリプト\n# 修正した機能の動作確認\n\n$ErrorActionPreference = \"Continue\"\n$logPath = \".cursor\\debug.log\"\n\nfunction Write-DebugLog {\n    param([string]$location, [string]$message, [hashtable]$data = @{})\n    $logEntry = @{\n        id = \"log_$(Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMddHHmmss')_$(New-Guid)\"\n        timestamp = [DateTimeOffset]::Now.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds()\n        location = $location\n        message = $message\n        data = $data\n        sessionId = \"debug-session\"\n        runId = \"real-world-test\"\n    } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress\n    Add-Content -Path $logPath -Value $logEntry -Encoding UTF8 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\n}\n\nWrite-Host \"========================================\" -ForegroundColor Cyan\nWrite-Host \" 実機テスト\" -ForegroundColor Cyan\nWrite-Host \"========================================\" -ForegroundColor Cyan\nWrite-Host \"\"\n\n# テスト1: バージョン確認\nWrite-Host \"Test 1: Version check\" -ForegroundColor Yellow\nWrite-DebugLog -location \"real-world-test.ps1:1\" -message \"バージョン確認テスト開始\"\ntry {\n    $versionOutput = codex --version 2&gt;&amp;1\n    Write-Host \"  Result: $versionOutput\" -ForegroundColor Green\n    Write-DebugLog -location \"real-world-test.ps1:2\" -message \"バージョン確認成功\" -data @{version = $versionOutput}\n} catch {\n    Write-Host \"  ❌ Failed: $($_.Exception.Message)\" -ForegroundColor Red\n    Write-DebugLog -location \"real-world-test.ps1:3\" -message \"バージョン確認失敗\" -data @{error = $_.Exception.Message}\n}\nWrite-Host \"\"\n\n# テスト2: ヘルプ表示\nWrite-Host \"Test 2: Help display\" -ForegroundColor Yellow\nWrite-DebugLog -location \"real-world-test.ps1:4\" -message \"ヘルプ表示テスト開始\"\ntry {\n    $helpOutput = codex --help 2&gt;&amp;1 | Select-Object -First 5\n    Write-Host \"  ✅ Help displayed successfully\" -ForegroundColor Green\n    Write-DebugLog -location \"real-world-test.ps1:5\" -message \"ヘルプ表示成功\"\n} catch {\n    Write-Host \"  ❌ Failed: $($_.Exception.Message)\" -ForegroundColor Red",

        "contents": "# CI/CDコマンド検証スクリプト\n# CI/CDで実行されるコマンドをローカルで実行して、問題を特定\n\n$ErrorActionPreference = \"Stop\"\n$logPath = \".cursor\\debug.log\"\n\n# ログファイルをクリア\nif (Test-Path $logPath) {\n    Remove-Item $logPath -Force\n}\n\nfunction Write-DebugLog {\n    param(\n        [string]$location,\n        [string]$message,\n        [hashtable]$data = @{},\n        [string]$hypothesisId = \"\"\n    )\n    $logEntry = @{\n        id = \"log_$(Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMddHHmmss')_$(New-Guid)\"\n        timestamp = [DateTimeOffset]::Now.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds()\n        location = $location\n        message = $message\n        data = $data\n        sessionId = \"debug-session\"\n        runId = \"run1\"\n        hypothesisId = $hypothesisId\n    } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress\n    Add-Content -Path $logPath -Value $logEntry -Encoding UTF8\n}\n\nWrite-DebugLog -location \"verify_ci_commands.ps1:1\" -message \"CI/CD検証スクリプト開始\" -hypothesisId \"A\"\n\n# 仮説A: コンパイルエラー\nWrite-DebugLog -location \"verify_ci_commands.ps1:2\" -message \"仮説A検証開始: コンパイルエラー\" -hypothesisId \"A\"\ntry {\n    Set-Location codex-rs\n    Write-DebugLog -location \"verify_ci_commands.ps1:3\" -message \"cargo check実行前\" -data @{cwd = (Get-Location).Path} -hypothesisId \"A\"",

        "contents": "try {\n    Set-Location codex-rs\n    Write-DebugLog -location \"verify_ci_commands.ps1:3\" -message \"cargo check実行前\" -data @{cwd = (Get-Location).Path} -hypothesisId \"A\"\n    \n    $checkOutput = cargo check --message-format=json 2&gt;&amp;1 | Out-String\n    Write-DebugLog -location \"verify_ci_commands.ps1:4\" -message \"cargo check実行後\" -data @{exitCode = $LASTEXITCODE; outputLength = $checkOutput.Length} -hypothesisId \"A\"\n    \n    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {\n        Write-DebugLog -location \"verify_ci_commands.ps1:5\" -message \"コンパイルエラー検出\" -data @{output = $checkOutput} -hypothesisId \"A\"\n        Write-Host \"❌ コンパイルエラーが検出されました\"\n        Write-Host $checkOutput\n    } else {\n        Write-DebugLog -location \"verify_ci_commands.ps1:6\" -message \"コンパイル成功\" -hypothesisId \"A\"\n        Write-Host \"✅ コンパイル成功\"\n    }\n} catch {\n    Write-DebugLog -location \"verify_ci_commands.ps1:7\" -message \"コンパイルエラー例外\" -data @{error = $_.Exception.Message} -hypothesisId \"A\"\n    Write-Host \"❌ コンパイルエラー: $($_.Exception.Message)\"\n}\n\nSet-Location ..\n\n# 仮説B: フォーマットエラー\nWrite-DebugLog -location \"verify_ci_commands.ps1:8\" -message \"仮説B検証開始: フォーマットエラー\" -hypothesisId \"B\"\ntry {\n    Set-Location codex-rs\n    Write-DebugLog -location \"verify_ci_commands.ps1:9\" -message \"cargo fmt --check実行前\" -hypothesisId \"B\"",

        "contents": "//! Rate limiting implementation for orchestrator\n//!\n//! Provides sliding window rate limiting to prevent DDoS attacks.\n\nuse serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};\nuse std::collections::HashMap;\nuse std::sync::Arc;\nuse std::time::{Duration, SystemTime};\nuse tokio::sync::RwLock;\n\n/// Rate limiter configuration\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\n#[serde(default)]\npub struct RateLimitConfig {\n    /// Enable rate limiting\n    pub enabled: bool,\n    /// Maximum requests per second\n    pub max_requests_per_sec: f64,\n    /// Burst size (maximum requests allowed in a short burst)\n    pub burst_size: usize,\n    /// Sliding window size in seconds\n    pub window_seconds: u64,\n}\n\nimpl Default for RateLimitConfig {\n    fn default() -&gt; Self {\n        Self {\n            enabled: true,\n            max_requests_per_sec: 10.0,\n            burst_size: 20,\n            window_seconds: 1,\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// Rate limiter entry for a client\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\nstruct RateLimitEntry {\n    /// Timestamps of recent requests (sliding window)\n    requests: Vec&lt;SystemTime&gt;,\n    /// Last cleanup time\n    last_cleanup: SystemTime,\n}\n\n/// Rate limiter\npub struct RateLimiter {\n    /// Rate limit configuration\n    config: RateLimitConfig,\n    /// Client entries (IP or token -&gt; entry)\n    entries: Arc&lt;RwLock&lt;HashMap&lt;String, RateLimitEntry&gt;&gt;&gt;,\n}\n\nimpl RateLimiter {\n    /// Create a new rate limiter",

        "contents": "//! Secret masking utilities for preventing sensitive information leakage\n//!\n//! Provides functions to mask API keys, tokens, passwords, and other sensitive\n//! data in logs, error messages, and debug output.\n\nuse once_cell::sync::Lazy;\nuse std::sync::Mutex;\n\n// Compile regex patterns once at startup\n// If compilation fails, we'll use a fallback that returns the original text\nstatic OPENAI_API_KEY_PROJ_REGEX: Lazy&lt;Result&lt;regex::Regex, regex::Error&gt;&gt; =\n    Lazy::new(|| regex::Regex::new(r\"sk-proj-[A-Za-z0-9]{32,}\"));\nstatic OPENAI_API_KEY_REGEX: Lazy&lt;Result&lt;regex::Regex, regex::Error&gt;&gt; =\n    Lazy::new(|| regex::Regex::new(r\"sk-[A-Za-z0-9]{32,}\"));\nstatic GITHUB_TOKEN_REGEX: Lazy&lt;Result&lt;regex::Regex, regex::Error&gt;&gt; =\n    Lazy::new(|| regex::Regex::new(r\"(ghp|gho|ghu|ghs|ghr)_[A-Za-z0-9]{36,}\"));\nstatic GOOGLE_API_KEY_REGEX: Lazy&lt;Result&lt;regex::Regex, regex::Error&gt;&gt; =\n    Lazy::new(|| regex::Regex::new(r\"AIzaSy[A-Za-z0-9_-]{35}\"));\nstatic BEARER_TOKEN_REGEX: Lazy&lt;Result&lt;regex::Regex, regex::Error&gt;&gt; =\n    Lazy::new(|| regex::Regex::new(r\"Bearer\\s+[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}\"));\nstatic PASSWORD_REGEX: Lazy&lt;Result&lt;regex::Regex, regex::Error&gt;&gt; =\n    Lazy::new(|| regex::Regex::new(r\"(?i)(password|pwd|pass|secret|token|api[_-]?key)\\s*[:=]\\s*([^\\s&amp;]+)\"));\nstatic URL_CREDENTIALS_REGEX: Lazy&lt;Result&lt;regex::Regex, regex::Error&gt;&gt; =\n    Lazy::new(|| regex::Regex::new(r\"https?://[^:]+:[^@]+@\"));\n\n// Track if regex compilation failed (for logging/debugging)\nstatic REGEX_COMPILATION_ERROR: Lazy&lt;Mutex&lt;Option&lt;String&gt;&gt;&gt; = Lazy::new(|| Mutex::new(None));\n\n/// Mask sensitive strings in text (API keys, tokens, passwords)\npub fn mask_secrets(text: &amp;str) -&gt; String {\n    // Patterns to detect and mask:\n    //",

        "contents": "# Codex Project Overview\n\n## Purpose\nCodex is an AI-Native Operating System with 4D Git Visualization &amp; VR/AR Support. It's a Rust-based AI development platform that integrates multiple AI models, MCP servers, and provides advanced features like sub-agent orchestration, deep research capabilities, and cross-platform compatibility.\n\n## Tech Stack\n- **Language**: Rust 2024 edition\n- **Build System**: Cargo workspace with multiple crates\n- **Key Dependencies**: \n  - Async runtime (tokio, async-trait)\n  - MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers\n  - OpenTelemetry for tracing\n  - TUI libraries (ratatui)\n  - HTTP clients (reqwest)\n- **Platforms**: Windows, macOS, Linux, VR/AR support\n\n## Extended Features (zapabob/codex)\n- **Sub-Agent System**: Multi-agent orchestration with parallel execution (2.6x speedup)\n- **Deep Research Engine**: Multi-source research with citation management (45x speedup)\n- **MCP Server Extensions**: 7 additional tools and enhanced integration\n- **Orchestration Framework**: Advanced async execution patterns\n- **Cross-platform Sandboxing**: Enhanced Windows, macOS, Linux support\n\n## Code Structure\n- &#96;core/&#96;: Core functionality and orchestration\n- &#96;cli/&#96;: Command-line interface\n- &#96;tui/&#96;: Terminal user interface\n- &#96;app-server/&#96;: Backend server\n- &#96;mcp-server/&#96;: MCP server implementation\n- &#96;deep-research/&#96;: Research engine\n- &#96;agents/&#96;: Sub-agent system\n- Various utility crates and integrations\n\n## Development Commands\n- &#96;just fmt&#96;: Format code with rustfmt\n- &#96;just fix&#96;: Run clippy with auto-fix\n- &#96;just clippy&#96;: Run clippy linting\n- &#96;just test&#96;: Run tests with cargo-nextest\n- &#96;cargo check --all-features&#96;: Check compilation\n- &#96;cargo build --release&#96;: Release build\n- &#96;cargo install --path codex-rs/cli --force&#96;: Install CLI\n\n## Windows-Specific Notes\n- Use PowerShell instead of bash\n- Commands like &#96;cd codex-rs &amp;&amp; cargo check --all-features&#96; should be split (PowerShell doesn't support &amp;&amp;)\n- Build artifacts go to &#96;target/&#96; directory (should be in .gitignore)\n- Use &#96;cargo install&#96; for installing binaries",

        "contents": "# Codex Build &amp; Install Guide\n\n**対象**: codex-rs (Rust workspace)  \n**最終更新**: 2025-10-12\n\n---\n\n## 🚀 クイックスタート\n\n### Option 1: 自動ビルド &amp; インストール（推奨）\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\n# codex-main ディレクトリまたは codex-rs ディレクトリから実行\n.\\codex-rs\\clean-build-install.ps1\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Option 2: エラー時の緊急修復\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\n.\\codex-rs\\emergency-repair.ps1\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## 📋 詳細手順\n\n### 1. 手動ビルド &amp; インストール\n\n#### ステップ1: ディレクトリ移動\n&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\ncd C:\\Users\\downl\\Desktop\\codex-main\\codex-main\\codex-rs\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### ステップ2: クリーンビルド\n&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\ncargo clean\ncargo build --release -p codex-cli\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### ステップ3: グローバルインストール\n&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\n# 既存プロセスを停止\nGet-Process codex -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force\n\n# インストール\nCopy-Item .\\target\\release\\codex.exe $env:USERPROFILE\\.cargo\\bin\\codex.exe -Force\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### ステップ4: 動作確認\n&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\ncodex --version\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## 🛠️ スクリプト詳細\n\n### clean-build-install.ps1\n\n**機能**:\n- ✅ 自動ディレクトリ検出（どこから実行しても OK）\n- ✅ ワークスペース検証\n- ✅ クリーンビルド（オプション）\n- ✅ コードフォーマット（just fmt / cargo fmt）\n- ✅ リリースビルド\n- ✅ バイナリ確認\n- ✅ グローバルインストール（リトライ3回）\n- ✅ 動作確認\n\n**オプション**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\n# クリーンをスキップ（高速化）\n.\\clean-build-install.ps1 -SkipClean\n\n# 詳細ログ表示\n.\\clean-build-install.ps1 -Verbose\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**出力**:\n- ログファイル: &#96;clean-build-install.log&#96;\n- バックアップ: &#96;~/.cargo/bin/codex.exe.backup-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS&#96;\n\n### emergency-repair.ps1\n\n**機能**:\n- ✅ 実行中プロセスの診断と停止\n- ✅ Cargo.lock のクリーン\n- ✅ target ディレクトリのクリーンアップ\n- ✅ 古いバックアップの削除\n- ✅ リリースビルド（エラー自動修復）",

        "contents": "# Codex Tauri - Installation Guide\n\nComplete installation guide for Codex AI-Native OS resident GUI client.\n\n## Prerequisites\n\n### Required Software\n\n1. **Node.js 18+**\n   - Download: https://nodejs.org/\n   - Verify: &#96;node --version&#96;\n\n2. **Rust 1.70+**\n   - Download: https://rustup.rs/\n   - Verify: &#96;rustc --version&#96;\n\n3. **Windows 10/11**\n   - Visual Studio Build Tools 2019+ (for native modules)\n   - Windows SDK\n\n### Optional (for Development)\n\n- Git\n- Visual Studio Code with Rust Analyzer extension\n\n## Installation from MSI\n\n### Step 1: Download Installer\n\nDownload the latest &#96;Codex_0.1.0_x64.msi&#96; from:\n- GitHub Releases (when available)\n- Or build from source (see below)\n\n### Step 2: Run Installer\n\n1. Double-click the MSI file\n2. Follow the installation wizard\n3. Choose installation directory (default: &#96;C:\\Program Files\\Codex&#96;)\n4. Complete installation\n\n### Step 3: First Launch\n\n1. Find \"Codex\" in Start Menu\n2. Or look for system tray icon (running in background)\n3. Right-click tray icon → \"Dashboard を開く\"\n\n## Building from Source\n\n### Step 1: Clone Repository\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncd C:\\Users\\YourName\\Projects\ngit clone https://github.com/zapabob/codex.git\ncd codex/codex-tauri\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 2: Install Dependencies\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\nnpm install\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 3: Build Application\n\n#### Development Build (faster)\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\nnpm run tauri:dev\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Production Build (optimized)\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\n.\\build.ps1\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nOr manually:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\nnpm run tauri build\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 4: Find Installer\n\nMSI installer will be located at:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\ncodex-tauri\\src-tauri\\target\\release\\bundle\\msi\\Codex_0.1.0_x64.msi\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Post-Installation Setup\n\n### 1. Configure Workspace\n\n1. Open Codex Dashboard\n2. Go to Dashboard page\n3. Enter your workspace path (e.g., &#96;C:\\Users\\YourName\\Projects\\myproject&#96;)\n4. Click \"Start Monitoring\"\n\n### 2. Enable Auto-start (Optional)\n\n1. Go to Settings\n2. Toggle \"Auto-start on Windows boot\"\n3. Codex will launch automatically on next boot\n\n### 3. Configure Codex Core",

        "contents": "# Codex Tauri - Installation Guide\n\nComplete installation guide for Codex AI-Native OS resident GUI client.\n\n## Prerequisites\n\n### Required Software\n\n1. **Node.js 18+**\n   - Download: https://nodejs.org/\n   - Verify: &#96;node --version&#96;\n\n2. **Rust 1.70+**\n   - Download: https://rustup.rs/\n   - Verify: &#96;rustc --version&#96;\n\n3. **Windows 10/11**\n   - Visual Studio Build Tools 2019+ (for native modules)\n   - Windows SDK\n\n### Optional (for Development)\n\n- Git\n- Visual Studio Code with Rust Analyzer extension\n\n## Installation from MSI\n\n### Step 1: Download Installer\n\nDownload the latest &#96;Codex_0.1.0_x64.msi&#96; from:\n- GitHub Releases (when available)\n- Or build from source (see below)\n\n### Step 2: Run Installer\n\n1. Double-click the MSI file\n2. Follow the installation wizard\n3. Choose installation directory (default: &#96;C:\\Program Files\\Codex&#96;)\n4. Complete installation\n\n### Step 3: First Launch\n\n1. Find \"Codex\" in Start Menu\n2. Or look for system tray icon (running in background)\n3. Right-click tray icon → \"Dashboard を開く\"\n\n## Building from Source\n\n### Step 1: Clone Repository\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncd C:\\Users\\YourName\\Projects\ngit clone https://github.com/zapabob/codex.git\ncd codex/codex-tauri\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 2: Install Dependencies\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\nnpm install\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 3: Build Application\n\n#### Development Build (faster)\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\nnpm run tauri:dev\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Production Build (optimized)\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\n.\\build.ps1\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nOr manually:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\nnpm run tauri build\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 4: Find Installer\n\nMSI installer will be located at:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\ncodex-tauri\\src-tauri\\target\\release\\bundle\\msi\\Codex_0.1.0_x64.msi\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Post-Installation Setup\n\n### 1. Configure Workspace\n\n1. Open Codex Dashboard\n2. Go to Dashboard page\n3. Enter your workspace path (e.g., &#96;C:\\Users\\YourName\\Projects\\myproject&#96;)\n4. Click \"Start Monitoring\"\n\n### 2. Enable Auto-start (Optional)\n\n1. Go to Settings\n2. Toggle \"Auto-start on Windows boot\"\n3. Codex will launch automatically on next boot\n\n### 3. Configure Codex Core",

        "contents": "## Install &amp; build\n\n### System requirements\n\n| Requirement                 | Details                                                         |\n| --------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- |\n| Operating systems           | macOS 12+, Ubuntu 20.04+/Debian 10+, or Windows 11 **via WSL2** |\n| Git (optional, recommended) | 2.23+ for built-in PR helpers                                   |\n| RAM                         | 4-GB minimum (8-GB recommended)                                 |\n\n### DotSlash\n\nThe GitHub Release also contains a [DotSlash](https://dotslash-cli.com/) file for the Codex CLI named &#96;codex&#96;. Using a DotSlash file makes it possible to make a lightweight commit to source control to ensure all contributors use the same version of an executable, regardless of what platform they use for development.\n\n### Build from source\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Clone the repository and navigate to the root of the Cargo workspace.\ngit clone https://github.com/openai/codex.git\ncd codex/codex-rs\n\n# Install the Rust toolchain, if necessary.\ncurl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs | sh -s -- -y\nsource \"$HOME/.cargo/env\"\nrustup component add rustfmt\nrustup component add clippy\n# Install helper tools used by the workspace justfile:\ncargo install just\n# Optional: install nextest for the &#96;just test&#96; helper (or use &#96;cargo test --all-features&#96; as a fallback)\ncargo install cargo-nextest\n\n# Build Codex.\ncargo build\n\n# Launch the TUI with a sample prompt.\ncargo run --bin codex -- \"explain this codebase to me\"\n\n# After making changes, use the root justfile helpers (they default to codex-rs):\njust fmt\njust fix -p &lt;crate-you-touched&gt;\n\n# Run the relevant tests (project-specific is fastest), for example:\ncargo test -p codex-tui\n# If you have cargo-nextest installed, &#96;just test&#96; runs the full suite:\njust test\n# Otherwise, fall back to:\ncargo test --all-features\n&#96;&#96;&#96;",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {

        "contents": "# コードベースレビューとビルドインストール\n\n**日時**: 2025-01-27 17:30:00  \n**タスク**: コードベースレビュー、起動済みプロセス停止、ビルド&amp;インストール\n\n---\n\n## 📋 実施内容\n\n### 1. コードベースレビュー\n\n#### プロジェクト構造確認\n- **ワークスペース**: &#96;codex-rs/&#96; (Rust workspace)\n- **メインクレート**: &#96;codex-cli&#96; (&#96;cli/Cargo.toml&#96;)\n- **バージョン**: 2.1.0 (workspace.package.version)\n\n#### ビルドシステム確認\n- **ビルドスクリプト**: &#96;clean-build-install.ps1&#96; 存在確認\n- **ビルドガイド**: &#96;BUILD_AND_INSTALL_GUIDE.md&#96; 確認済み\n- **ワークスペースメンバー**: 50+ crates 確認\n\n#### 主要コンポーネント\n- &#96;cli/&#96; - メインCLIアプリケーション\n- &#96;core/&#96; - コアランタイム\n- &#96;tui/&#96; - ターミナルUI\n- &#96;mcp-server/&#96; - MCPサーバー実装\n- &#96;exec/&#96; - 実行エンジン\n- &#96;supervisor/&#96; - プロセス管理\n\n### 2. 起動済みプロセス確認・停止\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\n# プロセス確認\nGet-Process | Where-Object {\n    $_.ProcessName -like \"*codex*\" -or \n    $_.ProcessName -like \"*cargo*\" -or \n    $_.ProcessName -like \"*rustc*\"\n}\n\n# 結果: 起動中のプロセスなし\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 3. ビルド&amp;インストール手順\n\n#### 手動ビルド手順\n&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\ncd codex-rs\n\n# 1. クリーンビルド\ncargo clean\n\n# 2. コードフォーマット\ncargo fmt --all\n# または\njust fmt\n\n# 3. リリースビルド\ncargo build --release -p codex-cli\n\n# 4. グローバルインストール\n$installPath = \"$env:USERPROFILE\\.cargo\\bin\\codex.exe\"\nGet-Process codex -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force\nCopy-Item \"target\\release\\codex.exe\" $installPath -Force\n\n# 5. 動作確認\ncodex --version\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### 自動スクリプト使用（推奨）\n&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\ncd codex-rs\n.\\clean-build-install.ps1\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 4. ビルドスクリプト機能\n\n&#96;clean-build-install.ps1&#96; の主な機能:\n- ✅ 自動ディレクトリ検出\n- ✅ ワークスペース検証",

        "contents": "- Auto-deployment: Binary generation, npm packaging, GitHub Releases\n\n---\n\n### 📦 Installation\n\n#### Option 1: npm (Recommended) ⭐\n\n**Available on npm**: [@zapabob/codex](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@zapabob/codex)\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Install globally\nnpm install -g @zapabob/codex\n\n# Verify installation\ncodex --version  # codex-cli 2.2.0\n\n# Update to latest version\nnpm update -g @zapabob/codex\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Features**:\n- ✅ Pre-built binaries for 8 platforms (Windows/macOS/Linux x64/ARM64)\n- ✅ Automatic platform detection\n- ✅ One-command installation\n- ✅ Automatic updates via npm\n\n#### Option 2: Cargo (From source)\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Prerequisites\nrustup install stable\ncargo install just\n\n# Clone repository\ngit clone https://github.com/zapabob/codex.git\ncd codex/codex-rs\n\n# Build and install\ncargo build --release -p codex-cli\ncargo install --path cli --force\n\n# Verify\ncodex --version\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Option 3: Binary releases\n\nDownload pre-built binaries from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/zapabob/codex/releases):\n\n- **Windows**: &#96;codex-windows-x64.exe&#96;\n- **macOS**: &#96;codex-macos-x64&#96; (Intel), &#96;codex-macos-arm64&#96; (Apple Silicon)\n- **Linux**: &#96;codex-linux-x64&#96;\n\n---\n\n### 🚀 Quick Start\n\n#### 1. Basic AI Coding\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Interactive TUI\ncodex\n\n# Non-interactive execution\ncodex exec \"Add error handling to main.rs\"\n\n# Resume last session\ncodex resume --last\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### 2. Plan Mode (New in v2.0.0)\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Create a plan\ncodex plan create \"Implement user authentication\" \\\n  --mode=orchestrated \\\n  --budget-tokens=50000\n\n# List plans\ncodex plan list\n\n# Approve and execute\ncodex plan approve &lt;plan-id&gt;\ncodex plan execute &lt;plan-id&gt;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### 3. Sub-Agent Delegation\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Single agent\ncodex delegate code-reviewer --scope ./src\n\n# Parallel agents (2.6x faster)\ncodex delegate-parallel code-reviewer,test-gen \\\n  --scopes ./src,./tests\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### 4. Git 4D Visualization\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Terminal UI (3D+time)\ncodex git-analyze --cuda\n\n# GUI (Three.js)\ncodex-gui  # Tauri app\n\n# VR mode (Quest 2/3/Pro)\n# Open in browser and click \"Enter VR\"",

        "contents": "# Codex Fast Build &amp; Install Script\n# Enforces zero warnings, performs differential build, and overwrites installation.\n\n$ErrorActionPreference = \"Stop\"\n$ProgressPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'\n\nfunction Write-Status {\n    param([string]$Message, [string]$Color = \"Cyan\")\n    Write-Host \"[*] $Message\" -ForegroundColor $Color\n}\n\nfunction Write-Success {\n    param([string]$Message)\n    Write-Host \"[OK] $Message\" -ForegroundColor Green\n}\n\nfunction Write-ErrorMsg {\n    param([string]$Message)\n    Write-Host \"[ERROR] $Message\" -ForegroundColor Red\n}\n\n# Ensure we are in the right directory\nif (-not (Test-Path \"Cargo.toml\")) {\n    Write-ErrorMsg \"Cargo.toml not found. Please run this script from the codex-rs directory.\"\n    exit 1\n}\n\n$env:RUSTFLAGS = \"-D warnings\"\n\n# Step 1: Type Check &amp; Linting (Zero Warnings)\nWrite-Status \"Step 1/4: Checking types and lints (Zero Warnings)...\"\ntry {\n    cargo check --workspace --all-targets --quiet\n    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw \"Cargo check failed\" }\n    Write-Success \"Type check passed with 0 warnings.\"\n} catch {\n    Write-ErrorMsg \"Type check failed or warnings found.\"\n    exit 1\n}\n\n# Step 2: Differential Build\nWrite-Status \"Step 2/4: Building codex-cli (Release, Incremental)...\"\ntry {\n    cargo build --release --package codex-cli --quiet\n    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw \"Build failed\" }\n    Write-Success \"Build completed.\"\n} catch {\n    Write-ErrorMsg \"Build failed.\"\n    exit 1\n}\n\n# Step 3: Kill Existing Processes\nWrite-Status \"Step 3/4: Stopping running codex processes...\"\n$CodexProcesses = Get-Process codex -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\nif ($CodexProcesses) {\n    $CodexProcesses | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\n    Start-Sleep -Seconds 1\n    Write-Success \"Processes stopped.\"\n} else {\n    Write-Success \"No running processes found.\"\n}\n\n# Step 4: Overwrite Install\nWrite-Status \"Step 4/4: Installing binary...\"\n$SourcePath = \".\\target\\release\\codex.exe\"\n$InstallPath = \"$env:USERPROFILE\\.cargo\\bin\\codex.exe\"",

        "contents": "# Codex Global Installation Script\n# Install Codex CLI globally on your system\n\nWrite-Host \"=== Codex Global Installation ===\" -ForegroundColor Green\n\n$repoPath = \"C:\\Users\\downl\\Desktop\\codex-main\\codex-main\"\nSet-Location $repoPath\n\n# Step 1: Build Rust binary (if not already built)\nWrite-Host \"&#96;nStep 1: Checking Rust binary...\" -ForegroundColor Yellow\n\nif (Test-Path \"codex-rs/target/release/codex.exe\") {\n    Write-Host \"Rust binary found!\" -ForegroundColor Green\n} else {\n    Write-Host \"Building Rust binary...\" -ForegroundColor Yellow\n    Set-Location codex-rs\n    cargo build --release --bin codex\n    Set-Location ..\n    \n    if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) {\n        Write-Host \"Build successful!\" -ForegroundColor Green\n    } else {\n        Write-Host \"Build failed!\" -ForegroundColor Red\n        exit 1\n    }\n}\n\n# Step 2: Create bin directory in codex-cli\nWrite-Host \"&#96;nStep 2: Preparing npm package...\" -ForegroundColor Yellow\n\n$binDir = \"codex-cli/bin\"\nif (-not (Test-Path $binDir)) {\n    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $binDir | Out-Null\n}\n\n# Copy binary to bin directory\nCopy-Item \"codex-rs/target/release/codex.exe\" \"$binDir/codex.exe\" -Force\nWrite-Host \"Binary copied to $binDir\" -ForegroundColor Green\n\n# Step 3: Create npm package\nWrite-Host \"&#96;nStep 3: Creating npm package...\" -ForegroundColor Yellow\nSet-Location codex-cli\n\n# Remove old tarball if exists\nRemove-Item \"*.tgz\" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\n\nnpm pack 2&gt;$null\n\nif ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) {\n    $tarball = Get-ChildItem \"*.tgz\" | Select-Object -First 1\n    Write-Host \"Package created: $($tarball.Name)\" -ForegroundColor Green\n} else {\n    Write-Host \"npm pack failed!\" -ForegroundColor Red\n    Set-Location ..\n    exit 1\n}\n\nSet-Location ..\n\n# Step 4: Global install\nWrite-Host \"&#96;nStep 4: Installing globally...\" -ForegroundColor Yellow\n\n$tarball = Get-ChildItem \"codex-cli/*.tgz\" | Select-Object -First 1\nnpm install -g $tarball.FullName 2&gt;$null\n\nif ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) {\n    Write-Host \"Global installation successful!\" -ForegroundColor Green",

        "contents": "# Phase 2 Complete Build and Install Script\n# Clean build, release build, and global install\n\nWrite-Host \"=== Phase 2 Complete Build and Install ===\" -ForegroundColor Cyan\nWrite-Host \"\"\n\n# Step 1: Navigate to codex-rs\nWrite-Host \"[Step 1/4] Navigating to codex-rs...\" -ForegroundColor Yellow\nSet-Location -Path \"codex-rs\"\nWrite-Host \"  Current directory: $(Get-Location)\" -ForegroundColor Gray\nWrite-Host \"\"\n\n# Step 2: Clean build\nWrite-Host \"[Step 2/4] Clean build...\" -ForegroundColor Yellow\ncargo clean\nWrite-Host \"  Clean completed\" -ForegroundColor Green\nWrite-Host \"\"\n\n# Step 3: Release build (with stability options)\nWrite-Host \"[Step 3/4] Release build with stability options (single-threaded, no incremental)...\" -ForegroundColor Yellow\nWrite-Host \"  This will take 15-20 minutes but is more stable...\" -ForegroundColor Gray\n$buildStart = Get-Date\ncargo build --release -p codex-cli -j 1\n$buildEnd = Get-Date\n$buildDuration = ($buildEnd - $buildStart).TotalMinutes\n\nif ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) {\n    Write-Host \"  Build completed in $([math]::Round($buildDuration, 2)) minutes\" -ForegroundColor Green\n} else {\n    Write-Host \"  Build failed!\" -ForegroundColor Red\n    Set-Location -Path \"..\"\n    exit 1\n}\nWrite-Host \"\"\n\n# Step 4: Global install\nWrite-Host \"[Step 4/4] Global install...\" -ForegroundColor Yellow\ncargo install --path cli --force\n\nif ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) {\n    Write-Host \"  Install completed\" -ForegroundColor Green\n} else {\n    Write-Host \"  Install failed!\" -ForegroundColor Red\n    Set-Location -Path \"..\"\n    exit 1\n}\nWrite-Host \"\"\n\n# Return to parent directory\nSet-Location -Path \"..\"\n\n# Verification\nWrite-Host \"=== Verification ===\" -ForegroundColor Cyan\nWrite-Host \"\"\n\nWrite-Host \"Codex version:\" -ForegroundColor Yellow\ncodex --version\nWrite-Host \"\"\n\nWrite-Host \"MCP server check:\" -ForegroundColor Yellow\ncodex mcp-server --help | Select-Object -First 3\nWrite-Host \"\"\n\nWrite-Host \"MCP list:\" -ForegroundColor Yellow\ncodex mcp list\nWrite-Host \"\"\n\nWrite-Host \"=== Phase 2 Build Complete! ===\" -ForegroundColor Green\nWrite-Host \"\"\nWrite-Host \"Next steps:\" -ForegroundColor Cyan",

          "endPosition": {

          }
        },
        "contents": "2. **PowerShellで取得**（フォールバック・必ず実行）\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\n   # PowerShellで現在日時を取得（実装ログ作成前に必ず実行）\n   $currentDateTime = Get-Date -Format \"yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss\"\n   $currentDate = Get-Date -Format \"yyyy-MM-dd\"\n   $currentTime = Get-Date -Format \"HH:mm:ss\"\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n3. **Pythonのdatetimeで取得**（代替方法）\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\n   # Pythonのdatetimeモジュールを使用\n   py -3 -c \"from datetime import datetime; print(datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S'))\"\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### 実装ログ作成手順（詳細）\n\n**STEP 1: 日時取得（必須・最初に実行）**\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\n# 方法1: PowerShellで取得（推奨）\n$currentDateTime = Get-Date -Format \"yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss\"\n$currentDate = Get-Date -Format \"yyyy-MM-dd\"\n\n# 方法2: Pythonで取得（代替）\n$currentDateTime = py -3 -c \"from datetime import datetime; print(datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S'))\"\n$currentDate = $currentDateTime.Substring(0, 10)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**STEP 2: ファイル名の決定**\n\n- 形式: &#96;yyyy-mm-dd_機能名.md&#96;\n- 例: &#96;2025-01-27_コードベースレビューとビルドインストール.md&#96;\n- **取得した日時を使用すること**\n\n**STEP 3: ログ作成**\n\n- &#96;_docs/&#96; ディレクトリに保存\n- 日時情報をログの先頭に記載: &#96;**日時**: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss&#96;\n- **取得した日時を使用すること**\n\n#### 完全な実装例\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\n# STEP 1: 現在日時を取得（必須・最初に実行）\n$currentDateTime = Get-Date -Format \"yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss\"\n$currentDate = Get-Date -Format \"yyyy-MM-dd\"\n\n# STEP 2: 実装ログファイル名を決定（取得した日時を使用）\n$logFileName = \"${currentDate}_機能名.md\"\n$logPath = \"_docs\\$logFileName\"\n\n# STEP 3: 実装ログを作成（取得した日時を記載）\n@\"\n# 機能名\n\n**日時**: $currentDateTime\n**タスク**: タスクの説明\n\n---\n\"@ | Out-File -FilePath $logPath -Encoding UTF8\n&#96;&#96;&#96;",

        "contents": "10. **MANDATORY**: Check file existence before playing audio\n11. **MANDATORY**: Play audio on ALL Agent task completions (success or error)\n12. **MANDATORY**: Play audio on ALL Plan phase completions (success or error)\n13. **MANDATORY**: Play audio on ALL major task completions (success or error)\n14. **MANDATORY**: Play audio on ALL test completions (success or error)\n15. **MANDATORY**: Play audio on ALL Ollama command completions (success or error)\n\n### 📝 実装ログ作成ルール (CRITICAL)\n\n**実装ログを作成する際は、必ず現在日時を取得してから作成すること:**\n\n#### 日時取得方法（優先順位順）\n\n1. **MCPサーバー経由で取得**（推奨）\n    &#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\n    # MCPサーバーが利用可能な場合\n    # 現在日時をMCPサーバー経由で取得\n    &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n2. **PowerShellで取得**（フォールバック）\n    &#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\n    # PowerShellで現在日時を取得\n    $currentDateTime = Get-Date -Format \"yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss\"\n    # または\n    $currentDate = Get-Date -Format \"yyyy-MM-dd\"\n    $currentTime = Get-Date -Format \"HH:mm:ss\"\n    &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### 実装ログ作成手順\n\n1. **日時取得**\n    - MCPサーバーが利用可能な場合はMCP経由で取得\n    - 利用不可の場合はPowerShellで取得: &#96;$currentDateTime = Get-Date -Format \"yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss\"&#96;\n\n2. **ファイル名の決定**\n    - 形式: &#96;yyyy-mm-dd_機能名.md&#96;\n    - 例: &#96;2025-01-27_コードベースレビューとビルドインストール.md&#96;\n\n3. **ログ作成**\n    - &#96;_docs/&#96; ディレクトリに保存\n    - 日時情報をログの先頭に記載: &#96;**日時**: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss&#96;\n\n#### 実装例\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\n# 1. 現在日時を取得\n$currentDateTime = Get-Date -Format \"yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss\"\n$currentDate = Get-Date -Format \"yyyy-MM-dd\"\n\n# 2. 実装ログファイル名を決定\n$logFileName = \"${currentDate}_機能名.md\"\n$logPath = \"_docs\\$logFileName\"\n\n# 3. 実装ログを作成\n@\"\n# 機能名\n\n**日時**: $currentDateTime\n**タスク**: タスクの説明\n\n---\n\"@ | Out-File -FilePath $logPath -Encoding UTF8",

        "contents": "# cursorrules実装ログ作成ルール追加\n\n**日時**: 2025-01-27 17:30:00  \n**タスク**: &#96;.cursorrules&#96;に実装ログ作成時の日時取得ルールを追加\n\n---\n\n## 📋 実施内容\n\n### 1. 現在日時取得方法の確認\n\n#### PowerShellでの取得方法\n&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\n# 日時を取得\n$currentDateTime = Get-Date -Format \"yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss\"\n$currentDate = Get-Date -Format \"yyyy-MM-dd\"\n$currentTime = Get-Date -Format \"HH:mm:ss\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### MCPサーバー経由での取得（将来対応）\n- MCPサーバーが利用可能な場合はMCP経由で取得を推奨\n- 現在はPowerShellでの取得をフォールバックとして使用\n\n### 2. &#96;.cursorrules&#96;へのルール追加\n\n#### 追加したセクション\n- **セクション名**: &#96;📝 実装ログ作成ルール (CRITICAL)&#96;\n- **場所**: &#96;## 🎯 Best Practices&#96; セクション内\n\n#### 追加内容\n\n1. **日時取得方法（優先順位順）**\n   - MCPサーバー経由で取得（推奨）\n   - PowerShellで取得（フォールバック）\n\n2. **実装ログ作成手順**\n   - 日時取得\n   - ファイル名の決定（&#96;yyyy-mm-dd_機能名.md&#96;形式）\n   - ログ作成（&#96;_docs/&#96;ディレクトリに保存）\n\n3. **実装例**\n   - PowerShellスクリプト例を記載\n   - 日時取得からログ作成までの一連の流れ\n\n4. **注意事項**\n   - 日時取得を忘れないこと\n   - ファイル名に日時を含める\n   - ログ本文にも日時を記載\n\n---\n\n## 🔍 追加されたルール詳細\n\n### 日時取得方法\n\n#### 1. MCPサーバー経由（推奨）\n&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\n# MCPサーバーが利用可能な場合\n# 現在日時をMCPサーバー経由で取得\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### 2.         "contents": "def create_implementation_log(script_dir, summary, build_duration=0):\n    \"\"\"実装ログを作成\"\"\"\n    # 現在日時を取得（PowerShell経由）\n    current_datetime = get_current_datetime()\n    current_date = current_datetime.split()[0]  # yyyy-MM-dd部分を抽出\n    \n    # ワークツリー名を取得\n    worktree_name = get_worktree_name(script_dir)\n    \n    # _docsディレクトリを確認\n    docs_dir = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(script_dir), \"_docs\")\n    if not os.path.exists(docs_dir):\n        os.makedirs(docs_dir, exist_ok=True)\n    \n    # ログファイル名\n    log_filename = f\"{current_date}_高速差分ビルド上書きインストール実機テスト{{{worktree_name}}}.md\"\n    log_path = os.path.join(docs_dir, log_filename)\n    \n    # ログ内容を生成\n    log_lines = []\n    log_lines.append(\"# 高速差分ビルド・上書きインストール・実機テスト\")\n    log_lines.append(\"\")\n    log_lines.append(f\"**日時**: {current_datetime}\")\n    log_lines.append(f\"**ワークツリー**: {worktree_name}\")\n    log_lines.append(f\"**実行ディレクトリ**: {script_dir}\")\n    log_lines.append(\"\")\n    log_lines.append(\"## 実行概要\")\n    log_lines.append(\"\")\n    log_lines.append(\"高速差分ビルド、バイナリの上書きインストール、実機テストを実行しました。\")\n    log_lines.append(\"\")\n    log_lines.append(\"## 実行結果\")\n    log_lines.append(\"\")\n    log_lines.append(\"### Phase 1: 高速差分ビルド\")\n    log_lines.append(\"\")\n    \n    if summary:",

        "contents": "    timestamp: OffsetDateTime,\n}\n\nfn create_log_file(\n    config: &amp;Config,\n    conversation_id: ConversationId,\n) -&gt; std::io::Result&lt;LogFileInfo&gt; {\n    // Resolve ~/.codex/sessions/YYYY/MM/DD and create it if missing.\n    let timestamp = OffsetDateTime::now_local()\n        .map_err(|e| IoError::other(format!(\"failed to get local time: {e}\")))?;\n    let mut dir = config.codex_home.clone();\n    dir.push(SESSIONS_SUBDIR);\n    dir.push(timestamp.year().to_string());\n    dir.push(format!(\"{:02}\", u8::from(timestamp.month())));\n    dir.push(format!(\"{:02}\", timestamp.day()));\n    fs::create_dir_all(&amp;dir)?;\n\n    // Custom format for YYYY-MM-DDThh-mm-ss. Use &#96;-&#96; instead of &#96;:&#96; for\n    // compatibility with filesystems that do not allow colons in filenames.\n    let format: &amp;[FormatItem] =\n        format_description!(\"[year]-[month]-[day]T[hour]-[minute]-[second]\");\n    let date_str = timestamp\n        .format(format)\n        .map_err(|e| IoError::other(format!(\"failed to format timestamp: {e}\")))?;\n\n    let filename = format!(\"rollout-{date_str}-{conversation_id}.jsonl\");\n\n    let path = dir.join(filename);\n    let file = std::fs::OpenOptions::new()\n        .append(true)\n        .create(true)\n        .open(&amp;path)?;\n\n    Ok(LogFileInfo {\n        file,\n        path,\n        conversation_id,\n        timestamp,\n    })\n}\n\nasync fn rollout_writer(\n    file: tokio::fs::File,",

        "contents": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-\n\"\"\"CI/CD失敗修正の実装ログを保存\"\"\"\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom datetime import datetime\n\n# Windows環境での文字エンコーディング対策\nif sys.platform == 'win32':\n    import io\n    sys.stdout = io.TextIOWrapper(sys.stdout.buffer, encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')\n    sys.stderr = io.TextIOWrapper(sys.stderr.buffer, encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')\n\ndef main():\n    docs_dir = Path(\"..\") / \"_docs\"\n    if not docs_dir.exists():\n        docs_dir = Path(\"_docs\")\n    \n    timestamp = datetime.now().strftime(\"%Y-%m-%d\")\n    log_file = docs_dir / f\"{timestamp}_CICD失敗修正{{main}}.md\"\n    \n    content = f\"\"\"# CI/CD失敗修正\n\n**日時**: {datetime.now().strftime(\"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S\")}\n**ワークツリー**: main\n**タスク**: zapabob/codexのCI/CDワークフロー失敗を修正\n\n---\n\n## 問題の分析\n\nすべてのCI/CDワークフローが失敗している原因：\n\n1. **Rust 2024 editionでのunsafe関数呼び出し**: &#96;env::set_var&#96;と&#96;env::remove_var&#96;がunsafe関数になったため、unsafeブロックが必要\n2. **MultitoolCli構造体のパターンマッチング**: 新しいフィールドが追加されたが、パターンマッチングで&#96;..&#96;が使用されていない\n\n---\n\n## 修正内容\n\n### 1. integration_web_search.rsのunsafe関数呼び出し修正\n\n**ファイル**: &#96;codex-rs/deep-research/tests/integration_web_search.rs&#96;\n\n**修正箇所**:\n- Line 15: &#96;env::set_var(\"BRAVE_API_KEY\", ...)&#96; → unsafeブロックで囲む\n- Line 35-36: &#96;env::set_var(\"GOOGLE_API_KEY\", ...)&#96; と &#96;env::set_var(\"GOOGLE_CSE_ID\", ...)&#96; → unsafeブロックで囲む\n- Line 54: &#96;env::set_var(\"BING_API_KEY\", ...)&#96; → unsafeブロックで囲む\n- Line 85-88: &#96;env::remove_var(...)&#96; (4箇所) → unsafeブロックで囲む\n- Line 113: &#96;env::set_var(\"BRAVE_API_KEY\", ...)&#96; → unsafeブロックで囲む\n\n**修正方法**:\nすべての&#96;env::set_var&#96;と&#96;env::remove_var&#96;呼び出しを&#96;unsafe ",

Result&lt;Self&gt; {\n        let storage = Arc::new(FileStorage::new(log_dir).await?) as Arc&lt;dyn AuditStorage&gt;;\n\n        let logger = Self {\n            storage,\n            session_id: None,\n            auto_flush_interval: Duration::from_secs(5),\n        };\n\n        // Start background flush task\n        logger.start_auto_flush().await;\n\n        info!(\"Audit logger initialized\");\n\n        Ok(logger)\n    }\n\n    /// Set session ID for all events\n    pub fn with_session(mut self, session_id: String) -&gt;         "contents": "fn now_ts() -&gt; String {\n    // RFC3339 for readability; consumers can parse as needed.\n    chrono::Utc::now().to_rfc3339_opts(chrono::SecondsFormat::Millis, true)\n}\n\npub(crate) fn maybe_init(config: &amp;Config) {\n    let enabled = std::env::var(\"CODEX_TUI_RECORD_SESSION\")\n        .map(|v| matches!(v.as_str(), \"1\" | \"true\" | \"TRUE\" | \"yes\" | \"YES\"))\n        .unwrap_or(false);\n    if !enabled {\n        return;\n    }\n\n    let path = if let Ok(path) = std::env::var(\"CODEX_TUI_SESSION_LOG_PATH\") {\n        PathBuf::from(path)\n    } else {\n        let mut p = match codex_core::config::log_dir(config) {\n            Ok(dir) =&gt; dir,\n            Err(_) =&gt; std::env::temp_dir(),\n        };\n        let filename = format!(\n            \"session-{}.jsonl\",\n            chrono::Utc::now().format(\"%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ\")\n        );\n        p.push(filename);\n        p\n    };\n\n    if let Err(e) = LOGGER.open(path.clone()) {\n        tracing::error!(\"failed to open session log {:?}: {}\", path, e);\n        return;\n    }\n\n    // Write a header record so we can attach context.\n    let header = json!({\n        \"ts\": now_ts(),\n        \"dir\": \"meta\",\n        \"kind\": \"session_start\",\n        \"cwd\": config.cwd,\n        \"model\": config.model,\n        \"model_provider_id\": config.model_provider_id,\n        \"model_provider_name\": config.model_provider.name,\n    });\n    LOGGER.write_json_line(header);\n}\n\npub(crate) fn log_inbound_app_event",

2. **tqdm風の進捗表示機能**

   - コンパイル中のクレート名を表示

3. **実装ログの作成**
   - `_docs/2025-12-30_高速差分ビルド上書きインストール実機テスト{main}.md`を作成
   - 現在日時（2025-12-30 18:35:37）を記録
   - 実行手順とスクリプトの改良点を記載

## 実行方法

以下のコマンドで実行できます：

```powershell
# プロジェクトルートから
cd C:\Users\downl\Desktop\codex-main\codex-rs
py -3 fast_build_install_test.py
```

スクリプトは以下を実行します：
1. **Phase 0**: `cargo clean`でビルドキャッシュをクリーン
2. **Phase 1**: `cargo build --release -p codex-cli`で高速差分ビルド（tqdm風の進捗表示付き）
3. **Phase 2**: バイナリを`$env:USERPROFILE\.cargo\bin\codex.exe`に上書きインストール
4. **Phase 3**: 実機テスト（`codex --version`、`codex --help`）
5. **完了時**: 実装ログを自動生成し、完了音声を再生

実装ログは`_docs/`ディレクトリに保存され、実行結果が記録されます。

        "contents": "#### commandExecution\n\n- &#96;item/commandExecution/outputDelta&#96; — streams stdout/stderr for the command; append deltas in order to render live output alongside &#96;aggregatedOutput&#96; in the final item.\n  Final &#96;commandExecution&#96; items include parsed &#96;commandActions&#96;, &#96;status&#96;, &#96;exitCode&#96;, and &#96;durationMs&#96; so the UI can summarize what ran and whether it succeeded.\n\n#### fileChange\n\n- &#96;item/fileChange/outputDelta&#96; - contains the tool call response of the underlying &#96;apply_patch&#96; tool call.\n\n### Errors\n\n&#96;error&#96; event is emitted whenever the server hits an error mid-turn (for example, upstream model errors or quota limits). Carries the same &#96;{ error: { message, codexErrorInfo? } }&#96; payload as &#96;turn.status: \"failed\"&#96; and may precede that terminal notification.\n\n&#96;codexErrorInfo&#96; maps to the &#96;CodexErrorInfo&#96; enum. Common values:\n\n- &#96;ContextWindowExceeded&#96;\n- &#96;UsageLimitExceeded&#96;\n- &#96;HttpConnectionFailed { httpStatusCode? }&#96;: upstream HTTP failures including 4xx/5xx\n- &#96;ResponseStreamConnectionFailed { httpStatusCode? }&#96;: failure to connect to the response SSE stream\n- &#96;ResponseStreamDisconnected { httpStatusCode? }&#96;: disconnect of the response SSE stream in the middle of a turn before completion\n- &#96;ResponseTooManyFailedAttempts { httpStatusCode? }&#96;\n- &#96;BadRequest&#96;\n- &#96;Unauthorized&#96;\n- &#96;SandboxError&#96;\n- &#96;InternalServerError&#96;\n- &#96;Other&#96;: all unclassified errors\n\nWhen an upstream HTTP status is available (for example, from the Responses API or a provider), it is forwarded in &#96;httpStatusCode&#96; on the relevant &#96;codexErrorInfo&#96; variant.\n\n## Approvals\n\nCertain actions (shell commands or modifying files) may require explicit user approval depending on the user's config. When &#96;turn/start&#96; is used, the app-server drives an approval flow by sending a server-initiated JSON-RPC request to the client. The client must respond to tell Codex whether to proceed. UIs should present these requests inline with the active turn so users can review the proposed command or diff before choosing.\n\n- Requests include &#96;threadId&#96; and &#96;turnId&#96;—use them to scope UI state to the active conversation.\n- Respond with a single &#96;{ \"decision\": \"accept\" | \"decline\" }&#96; payload (plus optional &#96;acceptSettings&#96; on command executions). The server resumes or declines the work and ends the item with &#96;item/completed&#96;.",

        "contents": "# codex-app-server\n\n&#96;codex app-server&#96; is the interface Codex uses to power rich interfaces such as the [Codex VS Code extension](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=openai.chatgpt).\n\n## Table of Contents\n\n- [Protocol](#protocol)\n- [Message Schema](#message-schema)\n- [Core Primitives](#core-primitives)\n- [Lifecycle Overview](#lifecycle-overview)\n- [Initialization](#initialization)\n- [API Overview](#api-overview)\n- [Events](#events)\n- [Auth endpoints](#auth-endpoints)\n\n## Protocol\n\nSimilar to [MCP](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/), &#96;codex app-server&#96; supports bidirectional communication, streaming JSONL over stdio. The protocol is JSON-RPC 2.0, though the &#96;\"jsonrpc\":\"2.0\"&#96; header is omitted.\n\n## Message Schema\n\nCurrently, you can dump a TypeScript version of the schema using &#96;codex app-server generate-ts&#96;, or a JSON Schema bundle via &#96;codex app-server generate-json-schema&#96;. Each output is specific to the version of Codex you used to run the command, so the generated artifacts are guaranteed to match that version.\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\ncodex app-server generate-ts --out DIR\ncodex app-server generate-json-schema --out DIR\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Core Primitives\n\nThe API exposes three top level primitives representing an interaction between a user and Codex:\n\n- **Thread**: A conversation between a user and the Codex agent. Each thread contains multiple turns.\n- **Turn**: One turn of the conversation, typically starting with a user message and finishing with an agent message. Each turn contains multiple items.\n- **Item**: Represents user inputs and agent outputs as part of the turn, persisted and used as the context for future conversations. Example items include user message, agent reasoning, agent message, shell command, file edit, etc.\n\nUse the thread APIs to create, list, or archive conversations. Drive a conversation with turn APIs and stream progress via turn notifications.\n\n## Lifecycle Overview\n\n- Initialize once: Immediately after launching the codex app-server process, send an &#96;initialize&#96; request with your client metadata, then emit an &#96;initialized&#96; notification. Any other request before this handshake gets rejected.\n- Start (or resume) a thread: Call &#96;thread/start&#96; to open a fresh conversation. The response returns the thread object and you’ll also get a &#96;thread/started&#96; notification. If you’re continuing an existing conversation, call &#96;thread/resume&#96; with its ID instead.",

        "contents": "    pub fn new(\n        auth_manager: Arc&lt;AuthManager&gt;,\n        conversation_manager: Arc&lt;ConversationManager&gt;,\n        outgoing: Arc&lt;OutgoingMessageSender&gt;,\n        codex_linux_sandbox_exe: Option&lt;PathBuf&gt;,\n        config: Arc&lt;Config&gt;,\n        cli_overrides: Vec&lt;(String, TomlValue)&gt;,\n        feedback: CodexFeedback,\n    ) -&gt; Self {\n        Self {\n            auth_manager,\n            conversation_manager,\n            outgoing,\n            codex_linux_sandbox_exe,\n            config,\n            cli_overrides,\n            conversation_listeners: HashMap::new(),\n            active_login: Arc::new(Mutex::new(None)),\n            pending_interrupts: Arc::new(Mutex::new(HashMap::new())),\n            turn_summary_store: Arc::new(Mutex::new(HashMap::new())),\n            pending_fuzzy_searches: Arc::new(Mutex::new(HashMap::new())),\n            feedback,\n        }\n    }\n\n    async fn load_latest_config(&amp;self) -&gt; Result&lt;Config, JSONRPCErrorError&gt; {\n        Config::load_with_cli_overrides(self.cli_overrides.clone())\n            .await\n            .map_err(|err| JSONRPCErrorError {\n                code: INTERNAL_ERROR_CODE,\n                message: format!(\"failed to reload config: {err}\"),\n                data: None,\n            })\n    }\n\n    fn review_request_from_target(\n        target: ApiReviewTarget,\n    ) -&gt;",

        "contents": "pub(crate) struct CodexMessageProcessor {\n    auth_manager: Arc&lt;AuthManager&gt;,\n    conversation_manager: Arc&lt;ConversationManager&gt;,\n    outgoing: Arc&lt;OutgoingMessageSender&gt;,\n    codex_linux_sandbox_exe: Option&lt;PathBuf&gt;,\n    config: Arc&lt;Config&gt;,\n    cli_overrides: Vec&lt;(String, TomlValue)&gt;,\n    conversation_listeners: HashMap&lt;Uuid, oneshot::Sender&lt;()&gt;&gt;,\n    active_login: Arc&lt;Mutex&lt;Option&lt;ActiveLogin&gt;&gt;&gt;,\n    // Queue of pending interrupt requests per conversation. We reply when TurnAborted arrives.\n    pending_interrupts: PendingInterrupts,\n    turn_summary_store: TurnSummaryStore,\n    pending_fuzzy_searches: Arc&lt;Mutex&lt;HashMap&lt;String, Arc&lt;AtomicBool&gt;&gt;&gt;&gt;,\n    feedback: CodexFeedback,\n}\n\n#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]\npub(crate) enum ApiVersion {\n    V1,\n    V2,\n}\n\nimpl CodexMessageProcessor {\n    async fn conversation_from_thread_id(\n        &amp;self,\n        thread_id: &amp;str,\n    ) -&gt; Result&lt;(ConversationId, Arc&lt;CodexConversation&gt;), JSONRPCErrorError&gt; {\n        // Resolve conversation id from v2 thread id string.\n        let conversation_id =\n            ConversationId::from_string(thread_id).map_err(|err| JSONRPCErrorError {\n                code: INVALID_REQUEST_ERROR_CODE,\n                message: format!(\"invalid thread id: {err}\"),\n                data: None,\n            })?;\n\n        let conversation = self\n            .conversation_manager\n            .get_conversation(conversation_id)\n            .await\n            .map_err(|_| JSONRPCErrorError {\n                code: INVALID_REQUEST_ERROR_CODE,\n                message: format!(\"conversation not found: {conversation_id}\"),\n                data: None,\n            })?;\n\n        Ok((conversation_id, conversation))\n    }\n    pub fn new(\n        auth_manager: Arc&lt;AuthManager&gt;,",

        "contents": "            ClientRequest::ReviewStart { request_id, params } =&gt; {\n                self.review_start(request_id, params).await;\n            }\n            ClientRequest::NewConversation { request_id, params } =&gt; {\n                // Do not tokio::spawn() to process new_conversation()\n                // asynchronously because we need to ensure the conversation is\n                // created before processing any subsequent messages.\n                self.process_new_conversation(request_id, params).await;\n            }\n            ClientRequest::GetConversationSummary { request_id, params } =&gt; {\n                self.get_conversation_summary(request_id, params).await;\n            }\n            ClientRequest::ListConversations { request_id, params } =&gt; {\n                self.handle_list_conversations(request_id, params).await;\n            }\n            ClientRequest::ModelList { request_id, params } =&gt; {\n                let outgoing = self.outgoing.clone();\n                let conversation_manager = self.conversation_manager.clone();\n                let config = self.config.clone();\n\n                tokio::spawn(async move {\n                    Self::list_models(outgoing, conversation_manager, config, request_id, params)\n                        .await;\n                });\n            }\n            ClientRequest::McpServerOauthLogin { request_id, params } =&gt; {\n                self.mcp_server_oauth_login(request_id, params).await;\n            }\n            ClientRequest::McpServerStatusList { request_id, params } =&gt; {\n                self.list_mcp_server_status(request_id, params).await;\n            }\n            ClientRequest::LoginAccount { request_id, params } =&gt; {\n                self.login_v2(request_id, params).await;\n            }\n            ClientRequest::LogoutAccount {\n                request_id,\n                params: _,\n            } =&gt; {\n                self.logout_v2(request_id).await;\n            }\n            ClientRequest::CancelLoginAccount { request_id, params } =&gt; {\n                self.cancel_login_v2(request_id, params).await;\n            }",

        "contents": "- &#96;turn/completed&#96; — &#96;{ turn }&#96; where &#96;turn.status&#96; is &#96;completed&#96;, &#96;interrupted&#96;, or &#96;failed&#96;; failures carry &#96;{ error: { message, codexErrorInfo? } }&#96;.\n- &#96;turn/diff/updated&#96; — &#96;{ threadId, turnId, diff }&#96; represents the up-to-date snapshot of the turn-level unified diff, emitted after every FileChange item. &#96;diff&#96; is the latest aggregated unified diff across every file change in the turn. UIs can render this to show the full \"what changed\" view without stitching individual &#96;fileChange&#96; items.\n- &#96;turn/plan/updated&#96; — &#96;{ turnId, explanation?, plan }&#96; whenever the agent shares or changes its plan; each &#96;plan&#96; entry is &#96;{ step, status }&#96; with &#96;status&#96; in &#96;pending&#96;, &#96;inProgress&#96;, or &#96;completed&#96;.\n\nToday both notifications carry an empty &#96;items&#96; array even when item events were streamed; rely on &#96;item/*&#96; notifications for the canonical item list until this is fixed.\n\n#### Items\n\n&#96;ThreadItem&#96; is the tagged union carried in turn responses and &#96;item/*&#96; notifications. Currently we support events for the following items:\n\n- &#96;userMessage&#96; — &#96;{id, content}&#96; where &#96;content&#96; is a list of user inputs (&#96;text&#96;, &#96;image&#96;, or &#96;localImage&#96;).\n- &#96;agentMessage&#96; — &#96;{id, text}&#96; containing the accumulated agent reply.\n- &#96;reasoning&#96; — &#96;{id, summary, content}&#96; where &#96;summary&#96; holds streamed reasoning summaries (applicable for most OpenAI models) and &#96;content&#96; holds raw reasoning blocks (applicable for e.g. open source models).\n- &#96;commandExecution&#96; — &#96;{id, command, cwd, status, commandActions, aggregatedOutput?, exitCode?, durationMs?}&#96; for sandboxed commands; &#96;status&#96; is &#96;inProgress&#96;, &#96;completed&#96;, &#96;failed&#96;, or &#96;declined&#96;.\n- &#96;fileChange&#96; — &#96;{id, changes, status}&#96; describing proposed edits; &#96;changes&#96; list &#96;{path, kind, diff}&#96; and &#96;status&#96; is &#96;inProgress&#96;, &#96;completed&#96;, &#96;failed&#96;, or &#96;declined&#96;.\n- &#96;mcpToolCall&#96; — &#96;{id, server, tool, status, arguments, result?, error?}&#96; describing MCP calls; &#96;status&#96; is &#96;inProgress&#96;, &#96;completed&#96;, or &#96;failed&#96;.\n- &#96;webSearch&#96; — &#96;{id, query}&#96; for a web search request issued by the agent.\n- &#96;imageView&#96; — &#96;{id, path}&#96; emitted when the agent invokes the image viewer tool.",

        "contents": "    async fn turn_start(&amp;self, request_id: RequestId, params: TurnStartParams) {\n        let (_, conversation) = match self.conversation_from_thread_id(&amp;params.thread_id).await {\n            Ok(v) =&gt; v,\n            Err(error) =&gt; {\n                self.outgoing.send_error(request_id, error).await;\n                return;\n            }\n        };\n\n        // Map v2 input items to core input items.\n        let mapped_items: Vec&lt;CoreInputItem&gt; = params\n            .input\n            .into_iter()\n            .map(V2UserInput::into_core)\n            .collect();\n\n        let has_any_overrides = params.cwd.is_some()\n            || params.approval_policy.is_some()\n            || params.sandbox_policy.is_some()\n            || params.model.is_some()\n            || params.effort.is_some()\n            || params.summary.is_some();\n\n        // If any overrides are provided, update the session turn context first.\n        if has_any_overrides {\n            let _ = conversation\n                .submit(Op::OverrideTurnContext {\n                    cwd: params.cwd,\n                    approval_policy: params.approval_policy.map(AskForApproval::to_core),\n                    sandbox_policy: params.sandbox_policy.map(|p| p.to_core()),\n                    model: params.model,\n                    effort: params.effort.map(Some),\n                    summary: params.summary,\n                })\n                .await;\n        }\n\n        // Start the turn by submitting the user input.         "contents": "            .await;\n    }\n\n    async fn send_user_turn(&amp;self, request_id: RequestId, params: SendUserTurnParams) {\n        let SendUserTurnParams {\n            conversation_id,\n            items,\n            cwd,\n            approval_policy,\n            sandbox_policy,\n            model,\n            effort,\n            summary,\n        } = params;\n\n        let Ok(conversation) = self\n            .conversation_manager\n            .get_conversation(conversation_id)\n            .await\n        else {\n            let error = JSONRPCErrorError {\n                code: INVALID_REQUEST_ERROR_CODE,\n                message: format!(\"conversation not found: {conversation_id}\"),\n                data: None,\n            };\n            self.outgoing.send_error(request_id, error).await;\n            return;\n        };\n\n        let mapped_items: Vec&lt;CoreInputItem&gt; = items\n            .into_iter()\n            .map(|item| match item {\n                WireInputItem::Text { text } =&gt; CoreInputItem::Text { text },\n                WireInputItem::Image { image_url } =&gt; CoreInputItem::Image { image_url },\n                WireInputItem::LocalImage { path } =&gt; CoreInputItem::LocalImage { path },\n            })\n            .collect();\n\n        let _ = conversation\n            .submit(Op::UserTurn {\n                items: mapped_items,\n                cwd,\n                approval_policy,\n                sandbox_policy,\n                model,\n                effort,\n                summary,\n                final_output_json_schema: None,\n            })\n            .await;\n\n        self.outgoing\n            .send_response(request_id, SendUserTurnResponse {})\n            .await;\n    }\n\n    async fn skills_list(&amp;self, request_id: RequestId,",

        "contents": "    fn review_request_from_target(\n        target: ApiReviewTarget,\n    ) -&gt; Result&lt;(ReviewRequest, String), JSONRPCErrorError&gt; {\n        fn invalid_request(message: String) -&gt; JSONRPCErrorError {\n            JSONRPCErrorError {\n                code: INVALID_REQUEST_ERROR_CODE,\n                message,\n                data: None,\n            }\n        }\n\n        let cleaned_target = match target {\n            ApiReviewTarget::UncommittedChanges =&gt; ApiReviewTarget::UncommittedChanges,\n            ApiReviewTarget::BaseBranch { branch } =&gt; {\n                let branch = branch.trim().to_string();\n                if branch.is_empty() {\n                    return Err(invalid_request(\"branch must not be empty\".to_string()));\n                }\n                ApiReviewTarget::BaseBranch { branch }\n            }\n            ApiReviewTarget::Commit { sha, title } =&gt; {\n                let sha = sha.trim().to_string();\n                if sha.is_empty() {\n                    return Err(invalid_request(\"sha must not be empty\".to_string()));\n                }\n                let title = title\n                    .map(|t| t.trim().to_string())\n                    .filter(|t| !t.is_empty());\n                ApiReviewTarget::Commit { sha, title }\n            }\n            ApiReviewTarget::Custom { instructions } =&gt; {\n                let trimmed = instructions.trim().to_string();\n                if trimmed.is_empty() {\n                    return Err(invalid_request(\n                        \"instructions must not be empty\".to_string(),\n                    ));\n                }\n                ApiReviewTarget::Custom {\n                    instructions: trimmed,\n                }\n            }\n        };\n\n        let core_target = match cleaned_target",

        "contents": "- &#96;webSearch&#96; — &#96;{id, query}&#96; for a web search request issued by the agent.\n- &#96;imageView&#96; — &#96;{id, path}&#96; emitted when the agent invokes the image viewer tool.\n- &#96;enteredReviewMode&#96; — &#96;{id, review}&#96; sent when the reviewer starts; &#96;review&#96; is a short user-facing label such as &#96;\"current changes\"&#96; or the requested target description.\n- &#96;exitedReviewMode&#96; — &#96;{id, review}&#96; emitted when the reviewer finishes; &#96;review&#96; is the full plain-text review (usually, overall notes plus bullet point findings).\n- &#96;compacted&#96; - &#96;{threadId, turnId}&#96; when codex compacts the conversation history. This can happen automatically.\n\nAll items emit two shared lifecycle events:\n\n- &#96;item/started&#96; — emits the full &#96;item&#96; when a new unit of work begins so the UI can render it immediately; the &#96;item.id&#96; in this payload matches the &#96;itemId&#96; used by deltas.\n- &#96;item/completed&#96; — sends the final &#96;item&#96; once that work finishes (e.g., after a tool call or message completes); treat this as the authoritative state.\n\nThere are additional item-specific events:\n\n#### agentMessage\n\n- &#96;item/agentMessage/delta&#96; — appends streamed text for the agent message; concatenate &#96;delta&#96; values for the same &#96;itemId&#96; in order to reconstruct the full reply.\n\n#### reasoning\n\n- &#96;item/reasoning/summaryTextDelta&#96; — streams readable reasoning summaries; &#96;summaryIndex&#96; increments when a new summary section opens.\n- &#96;item/reasoning/summaryPartAdded&#96; — marks the boundary between reasoning summary sections for an &#96;itemId&#96;; subsequent &#96;summaryTextDelta&#96; entries share the same &#96;summaryIndex&#96;.\n- &#96;item/reasoning/textDelta&#96; — streams raw reasoning text (only applicable for e.g. open source models); use &#96;contentIndex&#96; to group deltas that belong together before showing them in the UI.\n\n#### commandExecution\n\n- &#96;item/commandExecution/outputDelta&#96; — streams stdout/stderr for the command; append deltas in order to render live output alongside &#96;aggregatedOutput&#96; in the final item.\n  Final &#96;commandExecution&#96; items include parsed &#96;commandActions&#96;, &#96;status&#96;, &#96;exitCode&#96;, and &#96;durationMs&#96; so the UI can summarize what ran and whether it succeeded.",

`codex-app-server`のビルドエラーを修正しました。

## 修正内容

`codex-app-server`で、プロトコル定義に存在しないフィールドを参照していた箇所を修正しました。

### 修正した箇所

1. **`ThreadStartParams` (v2)**: `compact_prompt`、`model_context_window`、`model_auto_compact_token_limit`を削除
2. **`ThreadResumeParams` (v2)**: 同様のフィールドを削除
3. **`NewConversationParams` (v1)**: `model_context_window`と`model_auto_compact_token_limit`を削除（`compact_prompt`はv1に存在するため保持）

これらのフィールドは`config`の`HashMap`に含める必要があります。

### ビルド結果

```bash
✅ codex-app-server のビルド成功
   Finished `release` profile [optimized] target(s) in 17.02s
```

`codex-cli`のビルドは時間がかかりますが、`codex-app-server`のエラーは解消されました。続けて`codex-cli`のビルドを実行してください。

        "contents": "# DeepResearch機能の検索機能統合実装ログ\n\n**日時**: 2025年10月10日 15:15 JST  \n**作業者**: AI Assistant (なんJ風)  \n**目的**: DeepResearch機能を従来のWeb検索機能の拡張として実装\n\n---\n\n## 📋 実装概要\n\n従来のWeb検索（&#96;web_search&#96;）機能を拡張し、DeepResearch機能を統合した&#96;deep_web_search&#96;ツールを実装したで！  \nこれにより、モデルが浅い検索と深い多層リサーチを使い分けられるようになったんや💪\n\n---\n\n## 🎯 実装した機能\n\n### 1. DeepWebSearchツール (&#96;deep_web_search.rs&#96;)\n\n**場所**: &#96;codex-rs/core/src/tools/handlers/deep_web_search.rs&#96;\n\n#### パラメータ\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;rust\npub struct DeepWebSearchParams {\n    /// 検索クエリ（必須）\n    pub query: String,\n    \n    /// 検索深度（1-10、デフォルト: 2）\n    pub depth: u8,\n    \n    /// 最大ソース数（1-100、デフォルト: 10）\n    pub max_sources: usize,\n    \n    /// リサーチ戦略（comprehensive, focused, exploratory）\n    pub strategy: String,\n    \n    /// 結果のフォーマット（summary, detailed, json）\n    pub format: String,\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### リサーチ戦略\n\n1. **Comprehensive（包括的）** - 全ソースを徹底的に探索\n2. **Focused（集中）** - 高関連度ソースに絞った探索\n3. **Exploratory（探索的）** - 幅広い多様なソースを探索\n\n#### 出力フォーマット\n\n1. **Summary（サマリー）** - 簡潔な概要（デフォルト）\n   - クエリ、戦略、深度、ソース数\n   - 要約\n   - 主要な発見（5件）\n   - トップソース（10件）\n\n2. **Detailed（詳細）** - 完全な詳細レポート\n   - エグゼクティブサマリー\n   - 全ての発見\n   - 全てのソース（URL、関連度、スニペット、公開日）\n\n3. **JSON（生データ）** - 機械処理可能な完全なJSONレポート\n\n### 2. ツール統合 (&#96;tools/spec.rs&#96;)\n\n**変更箇所**:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;rust\n// ToolsConfigに新フィールド追加\npub struct ToolsConfig {\n    // ... 既存フィールド ...",

        "contents": "# 🎊 Codex Deep Research &amp; サブエージェント 完全統合実装完了レポート\n\n**実装日時**: 2025-10-11 13:44 - 14:30 JST  \n**プロジェクト**: zapabob/codex  \n**バージョン**: 0.47.0-alpha.1  \n**Status**: ✅ **Production Ready**\n\n---\n\n## 🎯 実装概要\n\n**OpenAI/codexのWeb検索機能**と**DuckDuckGo HTMLスクレイピング**を統合し、カスタムコマンドから呼び出せる完全なDeep Research &amp; サブエージェントシステムを実装しました。\n\n### 🌟 主要成果\n\n1. ✅ **APIキー不要のWeb検索実装**（DuckDuckGo統合）\n2. ✅ **3段階フォールバックチェーン実装**\n3. ✅ **カスタムコマンド実装**（&#96;codex research&#96; / &#96;codex delegate&#96;）\n4. ✅ **OpenAI/codex Web検索機能統合**\n5. ✅ **完全なドキュメント作成**（README + クイックスタート）\n6. ✅ **統合テスト合格**（3/3 passed）\n\n---\n\n## 📋 実装した機能\n\n### 1. Deep Research コマンド\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncodex research \"&lt;topic&gt;\" [OPTIONS]\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### 主なオプション\n\n| オプション | 説明 | デフォルト値 |\n|-----------|------|------------|\n| &#96;--depth &lt;N&gt;&#96; | 調査の深さ（1-5） | 3 |\n| &#96;--breadth &lt;N&gt;&#96; | ソース数 | 8 |\n| &#96;--budget &lt;N&gt;&#96; | トークン上限 | 60000 |\n| &#96;--citations&#96; | 引用を含める | true |\n| &#96;--mcp &lt;URL&gt;&#96; | MCP統合 | なし |\n| &#96;--lightweight-fallback&#96; | 軽量版使用 | false |\n| &#96;--out &lt;FILE&gt;&#96; | 出力先 | artifacts/report.md |\n\n#### 実装ファイル\n\n- &#96;codex-rs/cli/src/research_cmd.rs&#96; - コマンド実装\n- &#96;codex-rs/deep-research/src/web_search_provider.rs&#96; - Web検索実装\n- &#96;codex-rs/deep-research/src/lib.rs&#96; - ライブラリコア\n\n### 2. サブエージェント コマンド\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncodex delegate &lt;agent&gt; [OPTIONS]\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### 主なオプション\n\n| オプション | 説明 | デフォルト値 |\n|-----------|------|------------|\n| &#96;--goal &lt;TEXT&gt;&#96; | ゴール指定 | 自動生成 |\n| &#96;--scope &lt;PATH&gt;&#96; | 対象パス | 現在のディレクトリ |\n| &#96;--budget &lt;N&gt;&#96; | トークン上限 | 40000 |",

        "contents": "# DeepResearch機能の検索機能統合実装ログ\n\n**日時**: 2025年10月10日 15:15 JST  \n**作業者**: AI Assistant (なんJ風)  \n**目的**: DeepResearch機能を従来のWeb検索機能の拡張として実装\n\n---\n\n## 📋 実装概要\n\n従来のWeb検索（&#96;web_search&#96;）機能を拡張し、DeepResearch機能を統合した&#96;deep_web_search&#96;ツールを実装したで！  \nこれにより、モデルが浅い検索と深い多層リサーチを使い分けられるようになったんや💪\n\n---\n\n## 🎯 実装した機能\n\n### 1. DeepWebSearchツール (&#96;deep_web_search.rs&#96;)\n\n**場所**: &#96;codex-rs/core/src/tools/handlers/deep_web_search.rs&#96;\n\n#### パラメータ\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;rust\npub struct DeepWebSearchParams {\n    /// 検索クエリ（必須）\n    pub query: String,\n    \n    /// 検索深度（1-10、デフォルト: 2）\n    pub depth: u8,\n    \n    /// 最大ソース数（1-100、デフォルト: 10）\n    pub max_sources: usize,\n    \n    /// リサーチ戦略（comprehensive, focused, exploratory）\n    pub strategy: String,\n    \n    /// 結果のフォーマット（summary, detailed, json）\n    pub format: String,\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### リサーチ戦略\n\n1. **Comprehensive（包括的）** - 全ソースを徹底的に探索\n2. **Focused（集中）** - 高関連度ソースに絞った探索\n3. **Exploratory（探索的）** - 幅広い多様なソースを探索\n\n#### 出力フォーマット\n\n1. **Summary（サマリー）** - 簡潔な概要（デフォルト）\n   - クエリ、戦略、深度、ソース数\n   - 要約\n   - 主要な発見（5件）\n   - トップソース（10件）\n\n2. **Detailed（詳細）** - 完全な詳細レポート\n   - エグゼクティブサマリー\n   - 全ての発見\n   - 全てのソース（URL、関連度、スニペット、公開日）\n\n3. **JSON（生データ）** - 機械処理可能な完全なJSONレポート\n\n### 2. ツール統合 (&#96;tools/spec.rs&#96;)\n\n**変更箇所**:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;rust\n// ToolsConfigに新フィールド追加\npub struct ToolsConfig {\n    // ... 既存フィールド ...",

        "contents": "        let researcher = DeepResearcher::new(config.clone(), provider);\n\n        // Conduct research\n        let report = researcher\n            .research(&amp;request.query)\n            .await\n            .context(\"Research failed\")?;\n\n        // Filter sources by cross-source agreement (≥2 credible sources)\n        let filtered_sources = self.filter_by_agreement(&amp;report.sources);\n\n        // Calculate overall confidence from findings\n        let overall_confidence = if report.findings.is_empty() {\n            0.5\n        } else {\n            report.findings.iter().map(|f| f.confidence).sum::&lt;f64&gt;() / report.findings.len() as f64\n        };\n\n        // Convert to ResearchBlock\n        let research_block = ResearchBlock {\n            query: request.query.clone(),\n            depth: request.depth,\n            strategy: format!(\"{:?}\", request.strategy).to_lowercase(),\n            sources: filtered_sources\n                .iter()\n                .map(|s| ResearchSource {\n                    title: s.title.clone(),\n                    url: s.url.clone(),\n                    date: \"Unknown\".to_string(), // Source doesn't have date field\n                    key_finding: s.snippet.chars().take(200).collect(),\n                    confidence: s.relevance_score,\n                })\n                .collect(),\n            synthesis: report.summary,\n            confidence: overall_confidence,\n            needs_approval: self.requires_approval(),\n            timestamp: chrono::Utc::now(),\n        };\n\n        Ok(research_block)\n    }\n\n    /// Filter sources by cross-source agreement\n    fn filter_by_agreement(\n        &amp;self,\n        sources: &amp;[codex_deep_research::types::Source],\n    ) -&gt; Vec&lt;codex_deep_research::types::Source&gt; {\n        // For now, require relevance_score ≥ 0.7\n        // TODO: Implement actual cross-source agreement checking\n        sources\n            .iter()\n            .filter(|s| s.relevance_score &gt;= 0.7)\n            .cloned()\n            .collect()\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]",

        "contents": "        let researcher = DeepResearcher::new(config.clone(), provider);\n\n        // Conduct research\n        let report = researcher\n            .research(&amp;request.query)\n            .await\n            .context(\"Research failed\")?;\n\n        // Filter sources by cross-source agreement (≥2 credible sources)\n        let filtered_sources = self.filter_by_agreement(&amp;report.sources);\n\n        // Calculate overall confidence from findings\n        let overall_confidence = if report.findings.is_empty() {\n            0.5\n        } else {\n            report.findings.iter().map(|f| f.confidence).sum::&lt;f64&gt;() / report.findings.len() as f64\n        };\n\n        // Convert to ResearchBlock\n        let research_block = ResearchBlock {\n            query: request.query.clone(),\n            depth: request.depth,\n            strategy: format!(\"{:?}\", request.strategy).to_lowercase(),\n            sources: filtered_sources\n                .iter()\n                .map(|s| ResearchSource {\n                    title: s.title.clone(),\n                    url: s.url.clone(),\n                    date: \"Unknown\".to_string(), // Source doesn't have date field\n                    key_finding: s.snippet.chars().take(200).collect(),\n                    confidence: s.relevance_score,\n                })\n                .collect(),\n            synthesis: report.summary,\n            confidence: overall_confidence,\n            needs_approval: self.requires_approval(),\n            timestamp: chrono::Utc::now(),\n        };\n\n        Ok(research_block)\n    }\n\n    /// Filter sources by cross-source agreement\n    fn filter_by_agreement(\n        &amp;self,\n        sources: &amp;[codex_deep_research::types::Source],\n    ) -&gt; Vec&lt;codex_deep_research::types::Source&gt; {\n        // For now, require relevance_score ≥ 0.7\n        // TODO: Implement actual cross-source agreement checking\n        sources\n            .iter()\n            .filter(|s| s.relevance_score &gt;= 0.7)\n            .cloned()\n            .collect()\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]",

        "contents": "# 🎊 Codex Deep Research &amp; サブエージェント 完全統合実装完了レポート\n\n**実装日時**: 2025-10-11 13:44 - 14:30 JST  \n**プロジェクト**: zapabob/codex  \n**バージョン**: 0.47.0-alpha.1  \n**Status**: ✅ **Production Ready**\n\n---\n\n## 🎯 実装概要\n\n**OpenAI/codexのWeb検索機能**と**DuckDuckGo HTMLスクレイピング**を統合し、カスタムコマンドから呼び出せる完全なDeep Research &amp; サブエージェントシステムを実装しました。\n\n### 🌟 主要成果\n\n1. ✅ **APIキー不要のWeb検索実装**（DuckDuckGo統合）\n2. ✅ **3段階フォールバックチェーン実装**\n3. ✅ **カスタムコマンド実装**（&#96;codex research&#96; / &#96;codex delegate&#96;）\n4. ✅ **OpenAI/codex Web検索機能統合**\n5. ✅ **完全なドキュメント作成**（README + クイックスタート）\n6. ✅ **統合テスト合格**（3/3 passed）\n\n---\n\n## 📋 実装した機能\n\n### 1. Deep Research コマンド\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncodex research \"&lt;topic&gt;\" [OPTIONS]\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### 主なオプション\n\n| オプション | 説明 | デフォルト値 |\n|-----------|------|------------|\n| &#96;--depth &lt;N&gt;&#96; | 調査の深さ（1-5） | 3 |\n| &#96;--breadth &lt;N&gt;&#96; | ソース数 | 8 |\n| &#96;--budget &lt;N&gt;&#96; | トークン上限 | 60000 |\n| &#96;--citations&#96; | 引用を含める | true |\n| &#96;--mcp &lt;URL&gt;&#96; | MCP統合 | なし |\n| &#96;--lightweight-fallback&#96; | 軽量版使用 | false |\n| &#96;--out &lt;FILE&gt;&#96; | 出力先 | artifacts/report.md |\n\n#### 実装ファイル\n\n- &#96;codex-rs/cli/src/research_cmd.rs&#96; - コマンド実装\n- &#96;codex-rs/deep-research/src/web_search_provider.rs&#96; - Web検索実装\n- &#96;codex-rs/deep-research/src/lib.rs&#96; - ライブラリコア\n\n### 2. サブエージェント コマンド\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncodex delegate &lt;agent&gt; [OPTIONS]\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### 主なオプション\n\n| オプション | 説明 | デフォルト値 |\n|-----------|------|------------|\n| &#96;--goal &lt;TEXT&gt;&#96; | ゴール指定 | 自動生成 |\n| &#96;--scope &lt;PATH&gt;&#96; | 対象パス | 現在のディレクトリ |\n| &#96;--budget &lt;N&gt;&#96; | トークン上限 | 40000 |",

        },
        "contents": "# 🎊 Codex Deep Research &amp; サブエージェント 完全統合実装完了レポート\n\n**実装日時**: 2025-10-11 13:44 - 14:30 JST  \n**プロジェクト**: zapabob/codex  \n**バージョン**: 0.47.0-alpha.1  \n**Status**: ✅ **Production Ready**\n\n---\n\n## 🎯 実装概要\n\n**OpenAI/codexのWeb検索機能**と**DuckDuckGo HTMLスクレイピング**を統合し、カスタムコマンドから呼び出せる完全なDeep Research &amp; サブエージェントシステムを実装しました。\n\n### 🌟 主要成果\n\n1. ✅ **APIキー不要のWeb検索実装**（DuckDuckGo統合）\n2. ✅ **3段階フォールバックチェーン実装**\n3. ✅ **カスタムコマンド実装**（&#96;codex research&#96; / &#96;codex delegate&#96;）\n4. ✅ **OpenAI/codex Web検索機能統合**\n5. ✅ **完全なドキュメント作成**（README + クイックスタート）\n6. ✅ **統合テスト合格**（3/3 passed）\n\n---\n\n## 📋 実装した機能\n\n### 1. Deep Research コマンド\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncodex research \"&lt;topic&gt;\" [OPTIONS]\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### 主なオプション\n\n| オプション | 説明 | デフォルト値 |\n|-----------|------|------------|\n| &#96;--depth &lt;N&gt;&#96; | 調査の深さ（1-5） | 3 |\n| &#96;--breadth &lt;N&gt;&#96; | ソース数 | 8 |\n| &#96;--budget &lt;N&gt;&#96; | トークン上限 | 60000 |\n| &#96;--citations&#96; | 引用を含める | true |\n| &#96;--mcp &lt;URL&gt;&#96; | MCP統合 | なし |\n| &#96;--lightweight-fallback&#96; | 軽量版使用 | false |\n| &#96;--out &lt;FILE&gt;&#96; | 出力先 | artifacts/report.md |\n\n#### 実装ファイル\n\n- &#96;codex-rs/cli/src/research_cmd.rs&#96; - コマンド実装\n- &#96;codex-rs/deep-research/src/web_search_provider.rs&#96; - Web検索実装\n- &#96;codex-rs/deep-research/src/lib.rs&#96; - ライブラリコア\n\n### 2. サブエージェント コマンド\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncodex delegate &lt;agent&gt; [OPTIONS]\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### 主なオプション\n\n| オプション | 説明 | デフォルト値 |\n|-----------|------|------------|\n| &#96;--goal &lt;TEXT&gt;&#96; | ゴール指定 | 自動生成 |\n| &#96;--scope &lt;PATH&gt;&#96; | 対象パス | 現在のディレクトリ |\n| &#96;--budget &lt;N&gt;&#96; | トークン上限 | 40000 |",

        "contents": "pub mod contradiction;\npub mod evidence;\nmod gemini_search_provider;\nmod mcp_search_provider;\nmod pipeline;\npub mod planner;\npub mod provider;\nmod strategies;\npub mod types;\nmod url_decoder;\nmod web_search_provider;\n\nuse anyhow::Result;\nuse provider::ResearchProvider;\nuse std::sync::Arc;\nuse types::ResearchReport;\n\npub use contradiction::Contradiction;\npub use contradiction::ContradictionChecker;\npub use contradiction::ContradictionReport;\npub use evidence::CitationBuilder;\npub use evidence::Evidence;\npub use evidence::ResearchLog;\npub use gemini_search_provider::GeminiSearchProvider;\npub use mcp_search_provider::McpSearchProvider;\npub use mcp_search_provider::SearchBackend;\npub use planner::ResearchPlan;\npub use planner::ResearchPlanner;\npub use planner::StopConditions;\npub use provider::MockProvider;\npub use types::DeepResearcherConfig;\npub use types::ResearchStrategy;\npub use web_search_provider::WebSearchProvider;\n\n/// Main deep researcher for conducting comprehensive research\npub struct DeepResearcher {\n    config: DeepResearcherConfig,\n    provider: Arc&lt;dyn ResearchProvider&gt;,\n}\n\nimpl DeepResearcher {\n    /// Create a new deep researcher with the given configuration and provider\n    pub fn new(config: DeepResearcherConfig, provider: Arc&lt;dyn ResearchProvider&gt;) -&gt; Self {\n        Self { config, provider }\n    }\n\n    /// Conduct research on the given query\n    pub async fn research(&amp;self, query: &amp;str) -&gt; Result&lt;ResearchReport&gt; {\n        pipeline::conduct_research(Arc::clone(&amp;self.provider), &amp;self.config, query).await\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;",

## 完了した作業

### 1. web-searchクレートの作成
- `codex-rs/web-search/`を新規作成
- `WebSearchProvider`を`deep-research`から移動
- `url_decoder`を移動
- `Source`型を定義
- `ResearchProvider`トレイトを実装

### 2. deep-researchクレートの更新
- `web_search_provider.rs`と`url_decoder.rs`を削除
- `codex-web-search`への依存を追加
- `Source`型を`codex_web_search::Source`に変更
- `ResearchProvider`トレイトを`codex_web_search::ResearchProvider`に変更

### 3. 依存関係の更新
- `core`、`cli`、`mcp-server`に`codex-web-search`依存を追加
- すべての参照を`codex_web_search::WebSearchProvider`に更新

### 4. ビルドとインストール
- プロセスキル実行済み
- バックグラウンドでビルド実行中（cargo/rustcプロセス3個）

ビルド完了後、自動的にインストールが実行されます。実装ログは`_docs/2025-12-30_webresearchとDeepresearch分離実装{main}.md`に保存済みです。
